<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="id">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">\n<meta name="theme-color" content="#0B2A4A">\n<meta name="description" content="BSP Project Reporting System untuk monitoring progress, laporan harian, mingguan, bulanan, dan HSE.">
<title>BSP Report System | PT Banyumas Sudimara Perkasa</title>
<style>
:root{
  --navy:#0B2A4A; --navy2:#123A63; --navy3:#1B4E8C;
  --orange:#F28C28; --orange2:#FFA94D;
  --bg:#F4F6FA; --card:#FFFFFF; --line:#E2E8F0;
  --txt:#1A202C; --muted:#64748B;
  --green:#16A34A; --red:#DC2626; --amber:#D97706; --blue:#2563EB;
  --sh:0 2px 10px rgba(11,42,74,.08);
  --sh2:0 8px 28px rgba(11,42,74,.16);
  --r:12px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
body{font-family:'Segoe UI',system-ui,-apple-system,Roboto,Arial,sans-serif;background:var(--bg);color:var(--txt);font-size:14px}
button,input,select,textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:14px}
::-webkit-scrollbar{width:9px;height:9px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb{background:#c3cedd;border-radius:6px}
::-webkit-scrollbar-track{background:#eef2f7}

/* ========== LOGIN ========== */
#login{position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#0B2A4A 0%,#123A63 50%,#1B4E8C 100%);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:999;padding:16px}
#login::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:
  radial-gradient(circle at 15% 20%,rgba(242,140,40,.18),transparent 42%),
  radial-gradient(circle at 85% 80%,rgba(255,255,255,.10),transparent 45%)}
.loginbox{position:relative;background:#fff;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 24px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.4);width:100%;max-width:410px;padding:36px 32px;animation:pop .45s ease}
@keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px) scale(.97)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.logo-badge{width:150px;height:112px;margin:0 auto 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;background:#fff}
.logo-badge img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.sb-logo{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:9px;background:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden;flex-shrink:0;padding:2px}
.sb-logo img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain}
.loginbox h1{font-size:18px;text-align:center;color:var(--navy);line-height:1.35}
.loginbox .sub{text-align:center;color:var(--muted);font-size:12px;margin:6px 0 24px;letter-spacing:.4px}
.fld{margin-bottom:14px}
.fld label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--navy);margin-bottom:6px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px}
.fld input,.fld select,.fld textarea{width:100%;padding:11px 13px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:9px;outline:none;transition:.18s;background:#fff}
.fld input:focus,.fld select:focus,.fld textarea:focus{border-color:var(--navy3);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(27,78,140,.12)}
.btn{border:none;border-radius:9px;padding:11px 18px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;transition:.18s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;justify-content:center}
.btn:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.btn-pri{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy3));color:#fff;width:100%}
.btn-pri:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(11,42,74,.35)}
.btn-org{background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange2));color:#fff}
.btn-org:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(242,140,40,.4)}
.btn-gh{background:#fff;border:1.5px solid var(--line);color:var(--navy)}
.btn-gh:hover{border-color:var(--navy3);background:#f7f9fc}
.btn-sm{padding:6px 11px;font-size:12px;border-radius:7px}
.btn-dg{background:#FEE2E2;color:#B91C1C}
.btn-dg:hover{background:#FCA5A5}
.hint{background:#F1F5F9;border-radius:9px;padding:11px;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:18px;line-height:1.7}
.hint b{color:var(--navy)}

/* ========== LAYOUT ========== */
#app{display:none;min-height:100vh}
.sidebar{position:fixed;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:248px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--navy) 0%,#081F38 100%);color:#fff;z-index:100;display:flex;flex-direction:column;transition:.3s}
.sb-head{padding:20px 18px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:flex;gap:11px;align-items:center}
.sb-logo{width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--orange),var(--orange2));display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;flex-shrink:0}
.sb-head h2{font-size:12.5px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:700}
.sb-head span{font-size:9.5px;opacity:.6;letter-spacing:.6px}
.nav{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:12px 10px}
.nav-lbl{font-size:9.5px;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:.45;letter-spacing:1px;padding:14px 10px 6px;font-weight:700}
.nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:11px;padding:10px 12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);text-decoration:none;border-radius:9px;font-size:13.2px;margin-bottom:2px;transition:.16s;cursor:pointer}
.nav a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.09);color:#fff}
.nav a.on{background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--orange),rgba(242,140,40,.6));color:#fff;font-weight:700;box-shadow:0 3px 12px rgba(242,140,40,.3)}
.nav a i{width:19px;text-align:center;font-style:normal;font-size:15px}
.sb-foot{padding:13px 16px;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);font-size:10.5px;opacity:.55;line-height:1.6}
.main{margin-left:248px;transition:.3s}
.topbar{background:#fff;padding:13px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;box-shadow:var(--sh);position:sticky;top:0;z-index:50;flex-wrap:wrap}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:none;font-size:21px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--navy)}
.topbar h1{font-size:17px;color:var(--navy);flex:1;min-width:120px}
.topbar h1 small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);font-weight:400;margin-top:2px}
.usr{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;padding:6px 12px 6px 6px;background:var(--bg);border-radius:30px}
.ava{width:32px;height:32px;border-radius:50%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy3),var(--navy));color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px}
.usr .nm{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25}
.usr .rl{font-size:10px;color:var(--muted)}
.content{padding:22px 24px 50px}
.page{display:none;animation:fade .3s}
.page.on{display:block}
@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(8px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ========== COMPONENTS ========== */
.card{background:var(--card);border-radius:var(--r);box-shadow:var(--sh);padding:18px;margin-bottom:18px}
.card-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-bottom:15px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.card-h h3{font-size:14.5px;color:var(--navy);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.card-h h3::before{content:"";width:4px;height:17px;background:var(--orange);border-radius:3px}
.grid{display:grid;gap:15px}
.g2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}.g5{grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr)}
.kpi{background:#fff;border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;box-shadow:var(--sh);border-left:4px solid var(--navy3);position:relative;overflow:hidden;transition:.2s}
.kpi:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--sh2)}
.kpi .ic{position:absolute;right:12px;top:12px;font-size:26px;opacity:.14}
.kpi .lb{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.6px;font-weight:700}
.kpi .vl{font-size:26px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);margin:5px 0 2px;line-height:1}
.kpi .dl{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)}
.kpi.o{border-left-color:var(--orange)}.kpi.g{border-left-color:var(--green)}
.kpi.r{border-left-color:var(--red)}.kpi.b{border-left-color:var(--blue)}.kpi.a{border-left-color:var(--amber)}
.tbl-wrap{overflow-x:auto;border-radius:9px;border:1px solid var(--line)}
table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:12.8px;background:#fff}
th{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:10px 11px;text-align:left;font-weight:700;font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.4px;white-space:nowrap}
td{padding:9px 11px;border-bottom:1px solid #EDF1F6;vertical-align:middle}
tbody tr:hover{background:#F8FAFD}
tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:none}
.badge{display:inline-block;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:20px;font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap}
.b-g{background:#DCFCE7;color:#15803D}.b-a{background:#FEF3C7;color:#B45309}
.b-r{background:#FEE2E2;color:#B91C1C}.b-b{background:#DBEAFE;color:#1D4ED8}
.b-n{background:#E2E8F0;color:#475569}.b-o{background:#FFEDD5;color:#C2410C}
.pbar{height:7px;background:#E8EDF4;border-radius:5px;overflow:hidden;min-width:70px}
.pbar i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--navy3),var(--orange));border-radius:5px;transition:.5s}
.toolbar{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;margin-bottom:15px}
.toolbar input,.toolbar select{padding:8px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;outline:none;background:#fff}
.toolbar input:focus,.toolbar select:focus{border-color:var(--navy3)}
.empty{text-align:center;padding:42px 18px;color:var(--muted)}
.empty .em{font-size:44px;opacity:.3;display:block;margin-bottom:10px}

/* MODAL */
.modal{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(11,42,74,.6);display:none;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center;z-index:300;padding:22px 14px;overflow-y:auto;backdrop-filter:blur(2px)}
.modal.on{display:flex}
.mbox{background:#fff;border-radius:14px;width:100%;max-width:880px;box-shadow:0 24px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.4);animation:pop .3s;margin-bottom:30px}
.mbox.sm{max-width:520px}
.mh{padding:16px 20px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--navy),var(--navy3));color:#fff;border-radius:14px 14px 0 0;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;position:sticky;top:0;z-index:5}
.mh h3{font-size:15px}
.mh .x{background:rgba(255,255,255,.18);border:none;color:#fff;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:7px;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;line-height:1}
.mh .x:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.34)}
.mb{padding:20px}
.mf{padding:14px 20px;border-top:1px solid var(--line);display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;gap:9px;background:#FAFBFD;border-radius:0 0 14px 14px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sect{border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:10px;padding:15px;margin-bottom:15px}
.sect>h4{font-size:12px;color:var(--navy);text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.7px;margin-bottom:12px;padding-bottom:7px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--orange);display:inline-block}
.row{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-bottom:12px}
.r2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.r3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.r4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:62px}
.mini-tbl{width:100%;font-size:12px}
.mini-tbl th{background:#EEF2F7;color:var(--navy);padding:7px;font-size:10px}
.mini-tbl td{padding:4px}
.mini-tbl input,.mini-tbl select{width:100%;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:6px}
.chips{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.chip{padding:5px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:20px;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;transition:.15s;user-select:none}
.chip.on{background:var(--navy);color:#fff;border-color:var(--navy)}
.thumbs{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:9px}
.thumb{width:78px;height:78px;border-radius:8px;object-fit:cover;border:2px solid var(--line);position:relative}
.thumb-w{position:relative}
.thumb-w button{position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-6px;width:21px;height:21px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--red);color:#fff;border:2px solid #fff;cursor:pointer;font-size:12px;line-height:1}
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:22px;right:22px;background:var(--navy);color:#fff;padding:13px 19px;border-radius:10px;box-shadow:var(--sh2);z-index:999;display:none;animation:slide .3s;font-size:13px;max-width:330px}
@keyframes slide{from{transform:translateX(100%);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.toast.ok{background:var(--green)}.toast.er{background:var(--red)}.toast.wr{background:var(--amber)}
.tabs{display:flex;gap:5px;border-bottom:2px solid var(--line);margin-bottom:16px;overflow-x:auto}
.tabs button{background:none;border:none;padding:9px 15px;cursor:pointer;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600;border-bottom:3px solid transparent;margin-bottom:-2px;white-space:nowrap}
.tabs button.on{color:var(--navy);border-bottom-color:var(--orange)}
.tab-p{display:none}.tab-p.on{display:block}
.lgd{display:flex;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:9px;justify-content:center}
.lgd span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.lgd i{width:13px;height:13px;border-radius:3px;display:inline-block}
.detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 1fr;gap:8px 14px;font-size:13px}
.detail-grid dt{font-weight:700;color:var(--muted);font-size:11.5px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.3px}
.detail-grid dd{color:var(--txt)}
.help{font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin-top:4px}
.stat-line{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:8px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed var(--line);font-size:13px}
.stat-line:last-child{border:none}
.stat-line b{color:var(--navy)}

@media(max-width:1100px){.g5,.g4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.g3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .sidebar{transform:translateX(-100%)}.sidebar.open{transform:none;box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
  .main{margin-left:0}.burger{display:block}
  .g2,.g3,.g4,.g5{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .r2,.r3,.r4{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .content{padding:16px 13px 44px}.topbar{padding:11px 14px}
  .detail-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
/* Penyempurnaan tampilan mobile dan saat dipasang melalui iframe/embed */
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{min-width:320px;overflow-x:hidden}
button,a,input,select,textarea{touch-action:manipulation}
button:focus-visible,a:focus-visible,input:focus-visible,select:focus-visible,textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(242,140,40,.45);outline-offset:2px}
.modal{overscroll-behavior:contain}
.mbox{max-height:calc(100dvh - 44px);overflow:auto}
.mh{top:0}
@media(max-width:860px){
  .sidebar{width:min(290px,86vw)}
  .card{padding:14px}
  .kpi .vl{font-size:23px}
  .toolbar input,.toolbar select{max-width:100%;min-height:40px}
  .btn{min-height:38px}
  .mb{padding:14px}
  .sect{padding:11px}
  .mf{position:sticky;bottom:0;z-index:6}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{scroll-behavior:auto!important;animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
}
@media print{
  .sidebar,.topbar,.toolbar,.no-print,.mf{display:none!important}
  .main{margin:0}.content{padding:0}
  .card{box-shadow:none;border:1px solid #ccc;page-break-inside:avoid}
  body{background:#fff}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- ============ LOGIN ============ -->
<div id="login">
  <div class="loginbox">
    <div class="logo-badge"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo PT Banyumas Sudimara Perkasa"></div>
    <h1>PT BANYUMAS SUDIMARA PERKASA</h1>
    <div class="sub">PROJECT REPORTING SYSTEM</div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Email</label><input id="lu" type="email" placeholder="nama@perusahaan.co.id" autocomplete="username" required></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Password</label><input id="lp" type="password" placeholder="Masukkan password" autocomplete="current-password"></div>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn-pri" onclick="doLogin()">MASUK</button>

  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ APP ============ -->
<div id="app">
  <aside class="sidebar" id="sb">
    <div class="sb-head">
      <div class="sb-logo"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Logo BSP"></div>
      <div><h2>BANYUMAS SUDIMARA<br>PERKASA</h2><span>REPORT SYSTEM v1.0</span></div>
    </div>
    <nav class="nav">
      <div class="nav-lbl">Utama</div>
      <a class="on" data-p="dash"><i>📊</i> Dashboard</a>
      <a data-p="proj"><i>🏗️</i> Master Proyek</a>
      <div class="nav-lbl">Pelaporan</div>
      <a data-p="daily"><i>📅</i> Daily Report</a>
      <a data-p="weekly"><i>📆</i> Weekly Report</a>
      <a data-p="monthly"><i>🗓️</i> Monthly Report</a>
      <div class="nav-lbl">Analisa</div>
      <a data-p="budget"><i>💰</i> Budget Forecasting</a>
      <a data-p="material"><i>📦</i> Material Control</a>
      <a data-p="hse"><i>⛑️</i> HSE Monitoring</a>
      <a data-p="scurve"><i>📈</i> Kurva S & Progress</a>
      <div class="nav-lbl">Sistem</div>
      <a data-p="export"><i>📤</i> Export & Backup</a>
      <a data-p="setting"><i>⚙️</i> Pengaturan</a>
      <button type="button" id="logoutBtn" style="color:#FCA5A5" onclick="logout(event)"><i>🚪</i> Keluar</button>
    </nav>
    <div class="sb-foot">© 2025 PT BSP<br>Built with Precision,<br>Delivered with Integrity</div>
  </aside>

  <div class="main">
    <header class="topbar">
      <button class="burger" onclick="document.getElementById('sb').classList.toggle('open')">☰</button>
      <h1 id="ptitle">Dashboard<small id="psub">Ringkasan kinerja seluruh proyek</small></h1>
      <div class="usr"><div class="ava" id="uav">A</div><div><div class="nm" id="unm">Admin</div><div class="rl" id="url">Administrator</div></div></div>
    </header>

    <div class="content">

      <!-- ===== DASHBOARD ===== -->
      <section class="page on" id="p-dash">
        <div class="grid g5" style="margin-bottom:18px">
          <div class="kpi b"><span class="ic">🏗️</span><div class="lb">Total Proyek</div><div class="vl" id="k1">0</div><div class="dl" id="k1b">0 aktif</div></div>
          <div class="kpi o"><span class="ic">📈</span><div class="lb">Rata-rata Progress</div><div class="vl" id="k2">0%</div><div class="dl" id="k2b">Fisik aktual</div></div>
          <div class="kpi g"><span class="ic">📄</span><div class="lb">Total Laporan</div><div class="vl" id="k3">0</div><div class="dl" id="k3b">D / W / M</div></div>
          <div class="kpi a"><span class="ic">👷</span><div class="lb">Total Manhours</div><div class="vl" id="k4">0</div><div class="dl">Jam-orang</div></div>
          <div class="kpi r"><span class="ic">⛑️</span><div class="lb">Safety Record</div><div class="vl" id="k5">0</div><div class="dl" id="k5b">Incident</div></div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid g2">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-h"><h3>Kurva S — Plan vs Actual</h3>
              <select id="dashProj" onchange="renderDash()" style="padding:6px 10px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:7px"></select>
            </div>
            <div id="chartS"></div>
            <div class="lgd"><span><i style="background:#1B4E8C"></i>Rencana (Plan)</span><span><i style="background:#F28C28"></i>Realisasi (Actual)</span></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-h"><h3>Progress per Proyek</h3></div>
            <div id="chartB"></div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="grid g3">
          <div class="card">
            <div class="card-h"><h3>Distribusi Lingkup</h3></div>
            <div id="chartD"></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card" style="grid-column:span 2">
            <div class="card-h"><h3>Laporan Terbaru</h3><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="go('daily')">Lihat Semua →</button></div>
            <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Tgl</th><th>Jenis</th><th>Proyek</th><th>Progress</th><th>Pelapor</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody id="recentT"></tbody></table></div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== PROYEK ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-proj">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-h"><h3>Daftar Proyek</h3>
            <div style="display:flex;gap:8px"><button class="btn btn-org btn-sm" onclick="openProj()">➕ Tambah Proyek</button></div>
          </div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <input id="fProjQ" placeholder="🔍 Cari nama / kode / klien..." oninput="renderProj()" style="flex:1;min-width:180px">
            <select id="fProjS" onchange="renderProj()"><option value="">Semua Lingkup</option><option>SACME</option><option>FTTH</option><option>Optikal</option><option>Elektrikal</option><option>Struktur</option></select>
            <select id="fProjSt" onchange="renderProj()"><option value="">Semua Status</option><option>Perencanaan</option><option>On Going</option><option>Selesai</option><option>Ditunda</option></select>
          </div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table>
            <thead><tr><th>Kode</th><th>Nama Proyek</th><th>Klien</th><th>Lingkup</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Periode</th><th>Nilai Kontrak</th><th>Progress</th><th>Status</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody id="projT"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== DAILY ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-daily">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-h"><h3>Daily Progress Report (DPR)</h3><button class="btn btn-org btn-sm" onclick="openDaily()">➕ Buat Laporan Harian</button></div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <select id="fdProj" onchange="renderDaily()"><option value="">Semua Proyek</option></select>
            <input type="date" id="fdFrom" onchange="renderDaily()"><span style="color:var(--muted)">s/d</span><input type="date" id="fdTo" onchange="renderDaily()">
            <input id="fdQ" placeholder="🔍 Cari aktivitas/lokasi..." oninput="renderDaily()" style="flex:1;min-width:150px">
            <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="clearF('d')">↺ Reset</button>
          </div>
          <div class="grid g4" style="margin-bottom:14px">
            <div class="kpi b" style="padding:12px"><div class="lb">Laporan</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:21px" id="dS1">0</div></div>
            <div class="kpi o" style="padding:12px"><div class="lb">Total Manpower</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:21px" id="dS2">0</div></div>
            <div class="kpi g" style="padding:12px"><div class="lb">Manhours</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:21px" id="dS3">0</div></div>
            <div class="kpi r" style="padding:12px"><div class="lb">Kendala Terbuka</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:21px" id="dS4">0</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table>
            <thead><tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Proyek</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Cuaca</th><th>MP</th><th>MH</th><th>Prog. Hari</th><th>Kumulatif</th><th>Status</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody id="dailyT"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== WEEKLY ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-weekly">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-h"><h3>Weekly Progress Report (WPR)</h3><button class="btn btn-org btn-sm" onclick="openWeekly()">➕ Buat Laporan Mingguan</button></div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <select id="fwProj" onchange="renderWeekly()"><option value="">Semua Proyek</option></select>
            <input id="fwQ" placeholder="🔍 Cari ringkasan..." oninput="renderWeekly()" style="flex:1;min-width:150px">
            <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="clearF('w')">↺ Reset</button>
          </div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table>
            <thead><tr><th>Minggu</th><th>Periode</th><th>Proyek</th><th>Plan</th><th>Actual</th><th>Deviasi</th><th>MH</th><th>Status</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody id="weeklyT"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== MONTHLY ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-monthly">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-h"><h3>Monthly Progress Report (MPR)</h3><button class="btn btn-org btn-sm" onclick="openMonthly()">➕ Buat Laporan Bulanan</button></div>
          <div class="toolbar">
            <select id="fmProj" onchange="renderMonthly()"><option value="">Semua Proyek</option></select>
            <select id="fmYear" onchange="renderMonthly()"><option value="">Semua Tahun</option></select>
            <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="clearF('m')">↺ Reset</button>
          </div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table>
            <thead><tr><th>Periode</th><th>Proyek</th><th>Fisik Plan</th><th>Fisik Actual</th><th>Dev.</th><th>Keu. Plan</th><th>Keu. Actual</th><th>Status</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead>
            <tbody id="monthlyT"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== HSE ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-hse">
        <div class="grid g4" style="margin-bottom:18px">
          <div class="kpi g"><span class="ic">⏱️</span><div class="lb">Safe Manhours</div><div class="vl" id="h1">0</div><div class="dl">Tanpa kecelakaan</div></div>
          <div class="kpi a"><span class="ic">⚠️</span><div class="lb">Near Miss</div><div class="vl" id="h2">0</div><div class="dl">Hampir celaka</div></div>
          <div class="kpi r"><span class="ic">🚨</span><div class="lb">Incident / LTI</div><div class="vl" id="h3">0</div><div class="dl">Kecelakaan kerja</div></div>
          <div class="kpi b"><span class="ic">📋</span><div class="lb">Toolbox Meeting</div><div class="vl" id="h4">0</div><div class="dl">Sesi terlaksana</div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="grid g2">
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Statistik K3 per Proyek</h3></div>
            <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Proyek</th><th>Manhours</th><th>TBM</th><th>Near Miss</th><th>Incident</th><th>LTIFR</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody id="hseT"></tbody></table></div>
          </div>
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Tren Manhours Bulanan</h3></div><div id="chartH"></div></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Catatan Kendala & Insiden Lapangan</h3></div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Proyek</th><th>Kendala / Insiden</th><th>Tindakan</th><th>Status</th></tr></thead><tbody id="issueT"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== S-CURVE ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-scurve">
        <div class="card">
          <div class="card-h"><h3>Analisa Kurva S & Progress Proyek</h3>
            <select id="scProj" onchange="renderSC()" style="padding:7px 11px;border:1.5px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px"></select>
          </div>
          <div id="scInfo" class="grid g4" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
          <div id="chartSC"></div>
          <div class="lgd"><span><i style="background:#1B4E8C"></i>Rencana Kumulatif</span><span><i style="background:#F28C28"></i>Realisasi Kumulatif</span><span><i style="background:#16A34A"></i>Progress Harian</span></div>
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Rekap Progress Harian</h3></div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Tanggal</th><th>Aktivitas Utama</th><th>Volume</th><th>Prog. Harian</th><th>Kumulatif</th><th>Trend</th></tr></thead><tbody id="scT"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== BUDGET FORECASTING ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-budget">
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px;border:1px solid var(--line)">
          <div class="card-h"><h3>🔗 Korelasi Progress, Warehouse & Budget</h3><span class="badge b-b">Data lintas laporan</span></div>
          <div class="grid g3" style="margin-bottom:12px">
            <div class="fld"><label>Pilih Proyek untuk Analisis</label><select id="corrProject" onchange="renderCorrelation()"><option value="">Semua Proyek</option></select></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Periode Budget</label><input id="corrPeriod" type="month" onchange="renderCorrelation()"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Logika Forecast</label><div class="hint">Forecast biaya tetap memakai anggaran dan realisasi yang diinput. Progress dan stok menjadi indikator risiko pendukung.</div></div>
          </div>
          <div class="grid g4" id="corrKpi" style="margin-bottom:14px"></div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Sumber</th><th>Indikator</th><th>Hasil</th><th>Korelasi / Tindak Lanjut</th></tr></thead><tbody id="corrRows"></tbody></table></div>
          <div class="hint" style="margin-top:10px">Catatan: biaya material dari laporan harian belum dapat dihitung otomatis karena form pemakaian belum mencatat harga satuan. Masukkan realisasi dan estimasi sisa biaya pada Budget Forecasting agar forecast rupiah tetap akurat.</div>
        </div>
        <div class="grid g4" id="budgetKpi" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px"><div class="card-h"><h3>Tambah Budget / Forecast</h3></div>
          <div class="grid g3">
            <div class="fld"><label>Proyek</label><select id="bProject"></select></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Periode</label><input id="bPeriod" type="month"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Kategori Biaya</label><select id="bCategory"><option>Material</option><option>Tenaga Kerja</option><option>Alat & Sewa</option><option>Transportasi</option><option>Perizinan</option><option>Overhead</option><option>Lainnya</option></select></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Anggaran (Rp)</label><input id="bPlan" type="number" min="0" placeholder="0"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Realisasi (Rp)</label><input id="bActual" type="number" min="0" placeholder="0"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Estimasi sisa biaya (Rp)</label><input id="bRemain" type="number" min="0" placeholder="Opsional"></div>
            <div class="fld" style="grid-column:1/-1"><label>Catatan</label><input id="bNote" placeholder="Keterangan atau asumsi forecast"></div>
          </div><button class="btn btn-org" onclick="saveBudget()">💾 Simpan Budget</button>
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Rekap Budget & Forecast</h3><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="expCSV('budget')">📥 Export CSV</button></div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Proyek</th><th>Periode</th><th>Kategori</th><th>Anggaran</th><th>Realisasi</th><th>Forecast Akhir</th><th>Deviasi</th><th>Catatan</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="budgetRows"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== MATERIAL CONTROL ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-material">
        <div class="grid g4" id="materialKpi" style="margin-bottom:16px"></div>
        <div class="card" style="margin-bottom:16px"><div class="card-h"><h3>Tambah / Update Material</h3></div>
          <div class="grid g3">
            <div class="fld"><label>Proyek</label><select id="mProject"></select></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Kode Material</label><input id="mCode" placeholder="FO-CABLE-001"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Nama Material</label><input id="mName" placeholder="Kabel FO 24 Core"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Kategori</label><select id="mCategory"><option>Fiber Optic</option><option>ODC/ODP & Aksesoris</option><option>Material Civil</option><option>Tiang & Hardware</option><option>Consumable</option><option>Lainnya</option></select></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Satuan</label><input id="mUnit" placeholder="meter / pcs / drum"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Stok Awal</label><input id="mOpening" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Barang Masuk</label><input id="mIn" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Barang Keluar / Terpakai</label><input id="mOut" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Stok Minimum</label><input id="mMin" type="number" min="0" value="0"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Lokasi / Gudang</label><input id="mLocation" placeholder="Gudang proyek / site"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Supplier</label><input id="mSupplier" placeholder="Nama supplier"></div>
          </div><button class="btn btn-org" onclick="saveMaterial()">💾 Simpan Material</button>
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Stok Material Proyek</h3><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="expCSV('materials')">📥 Export CSV</button></div>
          <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Proyek</th><th>Kode</th><th>Material</th><th>Kategori</th><th>Masuk</th><th>Keluar</th><th>Stok Akhir</th><th>Min.</th><th>Status</th><th>Lokasi / Supplier</th><th></th></tr></thead><tbody id="materialRows"></tbody></table></div>
        </div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== EXPORT ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-export">
        <div class="grid g3">
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Export CSV / Excel</h3></div>
            <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:14px">Unduh data laporan dalam format CSV yang dapat dibuka dengan Microsoft Excel.</p>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px">
              <button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="expCSV('daily')">📥 Export Daily Report</button>
              <button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="expCSV('weekly')">📥 Export Weekly Report</button>
              <button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="expCSV('monthly')">📥 Export Monthly Report</button>
              <button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="expCSV('projects')">📥 Export Master Proyek</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Cetak Laporan (PDF)</h3></div>
            <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:14px">Cetak rekap laporan. Pilih "Save as PDF" pada dialog printer.</p>
            <div class="fld"><label>Pilih Proyek</label><select id="prProj"></select></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Jenis Laporan</label><select id="prType"><option value="daily">Daily Report</option><option value="weekly">Weekly Report</option><option value="monthly">Monthly Report</option><option value="all">Rekap Lengkap</option></select></div>
            <button class="btn btn-org" style="width:100%" onclick="printRecap()">🖨️ Cetak / Simpan PDF</button>
          </div>
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Backup & Restore</h3></div>
            <p style="color:var(--muted);font-size:12.5px;margin-bottom:14px">Simpan seluruh data ke file JSON atau pulihkan dari backup.</p>
            <div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:9px">
              <button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="backup()">💾 Download Backup (.json)</button>
              <label class="btn btn-gh" style="cursor:pointer">📂 Restore dari File<input type="file" accept=".json" onchange="restore(event)" hidden></label>
              <button class="btn btn-dg" onclick="resetAll()">🗑️ Hapus Semua Data</button>
            </div>
            <div class="hint" style="margin-top:14px"><b>⚠️ Perhatian:</b> Data tersimpan di browser (localStorage). Lakukan backup rutin agar data tidak hilang saat cache dibersihkan.</div>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Ringkasan Database</h3></div><div class="grid g4" id="dbStat"></div></div>
      </section>

      <!-- ===== SETTING ===== -->
      <section class="page" id="p-setting">
        <div class="grid g2">
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Identitas Perusahaan</h3></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Nama Perusahaan</label><input id="stNm"></div>
            <div class="fld"><label>Alamat</label><textarea id="stAd"></textarea></div>
            <div class="row r2"><div class="fld"><label>Telepon</label><input id="stTp"></div><div class="fld"><label>Email</label><input id="stEm"></div></div>
            <div class="row r2"><div class="fld"><label>Direktur Utama</label><input id="stDu"></div><div class="fld"><label>Website</label><input id="stWb"></div></div>
            <button class="btn btn-org" onclick="saveSet()">💾 Simpan Pengaturan</button>
          </div>
          <div class="card"><div class="card-h"><h3>Manajemen Pengguna</h3><button class="btn btn-org btn-sm" onclick="openUser()">➕ Tambah</button></div>
            <div class="tbl-wrap"><table><thead><tr><th>Nama</th><th>Username</th><th>Email</th><th>Role</th><th>Aksi</th></tr></thead><tbody id="userT"></tbody></table></div>
            <div class="hint" style="margin-top:12px"><b>Penyimpanan:</b> Data laporan disinkronkan ke Supabase cloud. Akun pengguna dikelola melalui Supabase Auth dan Edge Function. Tetap lakukan backup rutin.<br><br><b>Hak Akses:</b><br>• <b>Admin</b> — akses penuh, kelola user & hapus data<br>• <b>Project Manager</b> — buat, edit & approve laporan<br>• <b>Supervisor</b> — input laporan harian saja</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>

    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- ============ MODALS ============ -->
<div class="modal" id="mProj"><div class="mbox"><div class="mh"><h3 id="mProjT">Tambah Proyek</h3><button class="x" onclick="cls('mProj')">×</button></div>
<div class="mb">
  <input type="hidden" id="pjId">
  <div class="row r2"><div class="fld"><label>Kode Proyek *</label><input id="pjCode" placeholder="BSP-2025-001"></div><div class="fld"><label>Nama Proyek *</label><input id="pjName" placeholder="Pembangunan FTTH Cluster..."></div></div>
  <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Klien / Pemberi Kerja</label><input id="pjClient" placeholder="PT Telkom Indonesia"></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Lingkup Pekerjaan</label><select id="pjScope"><option>SACME</option><option>FTTH</option><option>Optikal</option><option>Elektrikal</option><option>Struktur</option><option>Multi-Scope</option></select></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Lokasi</label><input id="pjLoc" placeholder="Jakarta Selatan"></div></div>
  <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Tanggal Mulai</label><input type="date" id="pjStart"></div><div class="fld"><label>Target Selesai</label><input type="date" id="pjEnd"></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Nilai Kontrak (Rp)</label><input type="number" id="pjVal" placeholder="0"></div></div>
  <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Target Volume</label><input type="number" id="pjTv" placeholder="100"></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Satuan</label><select id="pjUnit"><option>Site</option><option>Homepass</option><option>Km</option><option>Core</option><option>Titik</option><option>Unit</option><option>m²</option><option>Lot</option></select></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Status</label><select id="pjSt"><option>Perencanaan</option><option>On Going</option><option>Selesai</option><option>Ditunda</option></select></div></div>
  <div class="row r2"><div class="fld"><label>Project Manager / PIC</label><input id="pjPm" placeholder="Nama PM / PIC proyek"></div><div class="fld"><label>Progress Rencana Saat Ini (%)</label><input type="number" id="pjPlan" min="0" max="100" value="0"></div></div>
  <div class="sect" style="margin-top:14px"><h4>🔐 Kredensial Akses Proyek</h4>
    <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Username Proyek</label><input id="pjAccessUser" autocomplete="off" placeholder="contoh: pm-ftth-jkt"></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Password Proyek</label><input id="pjAccessPass" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Isi bila akses diperlukan"></div>
    <div class="fld"><label>Hak Akses</label><select id="pjAccessRole"><option value="viewer">Viewer / Lihat saja</option><option value="spv">Site Supervisor</option><option value="pm">Project Manager</option><option value="admin">Administrator</option></select></div></div>
    <small style="color:var(--muted)">Kredensial ini dicatat sebagai informasi proyek. Pada versi HTML lokal, kredensial belum menjadi autentikasi terpisah dan tidak boleh digunakan untuk data rahasia.</small>
  </div>
  <div class="fld"><label>Keterangan</label><textarea id="pjNote" placeholder="Catatan ruang lingkup pekerjaan..."></textarea></div>
</div><div class="mf"><button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="cls('mProj')">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-org" onclick="saveProj()">💾 Simpan Proyek</button></div></div></div>

<div class="modal" id="mDaily"><div class="mbox"><div class="mh"><h3 id="mDailyT">Daily Progress Report</h3><button class="x" onclick="cls('mDaily')">×</button></div>
<div class="mb">
  <input type="hidden" id="dId">
  <div class="sect"><h4>A. Informasi Umum</h4>
    <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Proyek *</label><select id="dProj"></select></div><div class="fld"><label>Tanggal *</label><input type="date" id="dDate"></div><div class="fld"><label>Hari Ke-</label><input type="number" id="dDay" placeholder="1"></div></div>
    <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Lokasi / Site ID</label><input id="dLoc" placeholder="Site JKT-001 / Jl. Sudirman"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Cuaca</label><select id="dWth"><option>☀️ Cerah</option><option>⛅ Berawan</option><option>🌧️ Hujan Ringan</option><option>⛈️ Hujan Lebat</option><option>🌫️ Berkabut</option></select></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Jam Kerja</label><input id="dHour" placeholder="08:00 - 17:00" value="08:00 - 17:00"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>B. Tenaga Kerja (Manpower)</h4>
    <div class="row r4"><div class="fld"><label>Supervisor</label><input type="number" id="dmSv" value="0" oninput="calcMP()"></div><div class="fld"><label>Teknisi / Skilled</label><input type="number" id="dmTk" value="0" oninput="calcMP()"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Helper / Labour</label><input type="number" id="dmHp" value="0" oninput="calcMP()"></div><div class="fld"><label>Operator / Driver</label><input type="number" id="dmOp" value="0" oninput="calcMP()"></div></div>
    <div class="row r3"><div class="fld"><label>Total Manpower</label><input id="dmTot" readonly style="background:#F1F5F9;font-weight:700"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Jam Kerja/Orang</label><input type="number" id="dmJam" value="8" oninput="calcMP()"></div>
      <div class="fld"><label>Total Manhours</label><input id="dmMh" readonly style="background:#F1F5F9;font-weight:700;color:var(--orange)"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>C. Peralatan Digunakan</h4>
    <div class="chips" id="dEquip"></div>
    <div class="fld" style="margin-top:10px"><label>Peralatan Lainnya</label><input id="dEqOther" placeholder="Tulis alat lain, pisahkan dengan koma"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>D. Uraian Pekerjaan Hari Ini</h4>
    <table class="mini-tbl"><thead><tr><th style="width:44%">Uraian Aktivitas</th><th style="width:15%">Volume</th><th style="width:14%">Satuan</th><th style="width:18%">Keterangan</th><th style="width:9%"></th></tr></thead><tbody id="dActT"></tbody></table>
    <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" style="margin-top:9px" onclick="addAct()">➕ Tambah Baris Aktivitas</button>
  </div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>E. Material Terpakai</h4>

<div class="modal" id="mUser"><div class="mbox sm"><div class="mh"><h3>Tambah Pengguna</h3><button class="x" onclick="cls('mUser')">×</button></div>
<div class="mb"><input type="hidden" id="uId">
  <div class="fld"><label>Nama Lengkap</label><input id="uNm2"></div>
  <div class="fld"><label>Username</label><input id="uUn" autocomplete="off"></div>
  <div class="fld"><label>Email Login</label><input id="uEmail" type="email" placeholder="nama@perusahaan.co.id" autocomplete="off"></div>
  <div class="fld"><label>Password</label><input id="uPw" type="password" autocomplete="new-password" placeholder="Wajib untuk pengguna baru; kosongkan jika tidak diubah"></div>
  <div class="fld"><label>Role</label><select id="uRl"><option value="admin">Administrator</option><option value="pm">Project Manager</option><option value="spv">Site Supervisor</option></select></div>
</div><div class="mf"><button class="btn btn-gh" onclick="cls('mUser')">Batal</button><button class="btn btn-org" onclick="saveUser()">💾 Simpan</button></div></div></div>

<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@supabase/supabase-js@2"></script>
<script>
/* ================= DATA LAYER ================= */
const KEY='bsp_report_v1';
let DB={projects:[],daily:[],weekly:[],monthly:[],budgets:[],materials:[],users:[],
  settings:{name:'PT BANYUMAS SUDIMARA PERKASA',address:'Jl. Raya Sudimara No. XX, Tangerang Selatan, Banten',phone:'(021) 1234-5678',email:'info@bsp-perkasa.co.id',director:'Ade Riyadi',web:'www.bsp-perkasa.co.id'}};
let USER=null, PHOTOS=[];
const MONTHS=['Januari','Februari','Maret','April','Mei','Juni','Juli','Agustus','September','Oktober','November','Desember'];
const EQUIPS=['Fusion Splicer','OTDR','Power Meter','VFL','Excavator','Crane','Genset','Truck','Pickup','Bar Cutter','Concrete Mixer','Megger','Earth Tester','HDD Machine','Winch','Scaffolding','Man Lift','Theodolite'];

function localISODate(date=new Date()){
  const y=date.getFullYear(),m=String(date.getMonth()+1).padStart(2,'0'),d=String(date.getDate()).padStart(2,'0');
  return `${y}-${m}-${d}`;
}
function load(){
  try{
    const raw=localStorage.getItem(KEY);
    if(raw){
      const d=JSON.parse(raw);
      if(d&&typeof d==='object') DB={...DB,...d,
        projects:Array.isArray(d.projects)?d.projects:[], daily:Array.isArray(d.daily)?d.daily:[],
        weekly:Array.isArray(d.weekly)?d.weekly:[], monthly:Array.isArray(d.monthly)?d.monthly:[],
        budgets:Array.isArray(d.budgets)?d.budgets:[], materials:Array.isArray(d.materials)?d.materials:[],
        users:[], settings:d.settings&&typeof d.settings==='object'?{...DB.settings,...d.settings}:DB.settings
      };
    }
  }catch(e){console.warn('Data BSP tidak dapat dibaca:',e)}
}
let bspClient=null, cloudSaveChain=Promise.resolve(), cloudSaveErrorShown=false;
const BSP_SUPABASE_URL='https://hlutarcnfytfsbtgmysd.supabase.co';
const BSP_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY='sb_publishable_y5OYyhSnNlsH8TvnaUhnTA_H9Kb1Ikn';
function cloudPayload(){const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DB));copy.users=[];(copy.projects||[]).forEach(p=>{delete p.accessPass});return copy;}
function localPayload(){const copy=JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(DB));copy.users=[];return copy;}
async function cloudSaveNow(){
  if(!bspClient)return;
  const {data:{session}}=await bspClient.auth.getSession();
  if(!session)return;
  const {error}=await bspClient.from('bsp_app_state').upsert({id:'main',payload:cloudPayload(),updated_at:new Date().toISOString()},{onConflict:'id'});
  if(error)throw error;
}
function save(){
  try{
    // Keep a local recovery copy, but never store passwords in the report-state payload.
    const local=localPayload(), payload=JSON.stringify(local);
    localStorage.setItem(KEY,payload);
    if(localStorage.getItem(KEY)!==payload)throw new Error('Verifikasi penyimpanan lokal gagal');
    if(bspClient){
      cloudSaveChain=cloudSaveChain.then(()=>cloudSaveNow()).then(()=>{cloudSaveErrorShown=false}).catch(e=>{
        console.error('Sinkronisasi cloud BSP gagal:',e);
        if(!cloudSaveErrorShown){cloudSaveErrorShown=true;toast('Data lokal tersimpan, tetapi sinkronisasi cloud gagal: '+(e.message||'periksa koneksi dan kebijakan RLS'),'er')}
      });
    }
    return true;
  }catch(e){console.error('Gagal menyimpan data BSP:',e);toast('Gagal menyimpan data lokal. Periksa ruang penyimpanan browser.','er');return false;}
}
async function cloudLoadState(){
  const {data,error}=await bspClient.from('bsp_app_state').select('payload').eq('id','main').maybeSingle();
  if(error)throw error;
  if(data&&data.payload&&typeof data.payload==='object'){
    const d=data.payload;
    const localProjectSecrets=new Map((DB.projects||[]).map(p=>[String(p.id),p.accessPass]));
    const cloudProjects=Array.isArray(d.projects)?d.projects.map(p=>({...p,...(localProjectSecrets.has(String(p.id))?{accessPass:localProjectSecrets.get(String(p.id))}:{})})):[];
    DB={...DB,...d,users:[],projects:cloudProjects,daily:Array.isArray(d.daily)?d.daily:[],weekly:Array.isArray(d.weekly)?d.weekly:[],monthly:Array.isArray(d.monthly)?d.monthly:[],budgets:Array.isArray(d.budgets)?d.budgets:[],materials:Array.isArray(d.materials)?d.materials:[],settings:{...DB.settings,...(d.settings||{})}};
    return true;
  }
  // First login: copy existing local report data to the cloud only if the cloud is empty.
  await cloudSaveNow();
  return false;
}
async function currentProfile(user){
  const {data,error}=await bspClient.from('bsp_user_profiles').select('id,full_name,username,role').eq('id',user.id).single();
  if(error)throw error;
  return {id:data.id,name:data.full_name,username:data.username||user.email.split('@')[0],email:user.email,role:data.role};
}
async function refreshCloudUsers(){
  if(USER?.role!=='admin')return;
  const {data,error}=await bspClient.functions.invoke('bsp-admin-users',{body:{action:'list'}});
  if(error)throw error;
  if(!data?.users)throw new Error(data?.error||'Respons daftar pengguna tidak valid');
  DB.users=data.users.map(u=>({id:u.id,name:u.full_name,username:u.username||'',email:u.email||'',role:u.role}));
  renderSet();
}
async function enterApp(user){
  const profile=await currentProfile(user);
  USER=profile;
  await cloudLoadState();
  DB.users=[];
  if(USER.role==='admin')await refreshCloudUsers();
  else DB.users=[USER];
  // Replace old demo session data and persist only non-secret report data locally.
  try{sessionStorage.removeItem('bsp_user')}catch(e){}
  try{localStorage.setItem(KEY,JSON.stringify(localPayload()))}catch(e){}
  document.getElementById('login').style.display='none';
  document.getElementById('app').style.display='block';
  document.getElementById('unm').textContent=USER.name;
  document.getElementById('url').textContent=({admin:'Administrator',pm:'Project Manager',spv:'Site Supervisor',viewer:'Viewer'})[USER.role]||USER.role;
  document.getElementById('uav').textContent=(USER.name||'?').charAt(0).toUpperCase();
  initAll();
}
function uid(){return Date.now().toString(36)+Math.random().toString(36).substr(2,5)}
function toast(m,t='ok'){const e=document.getElementById('toast');e.textContent=m;e.className='toast '+t;e.style.display='block';clearTimeout(e._t);e._t=setTimeout(()=>e.style.display='none',3200)}
function esc(s){return String(s??'').replace(/[&<>"]/g,c=>({'&':'&amp;','<':'&lt;','>':'&gt;','"':'&quot;'}[c]))}
function nl(s){return esc(s).replace(/\n/g,'<br>')}
function fmtD(d){if(!d)return '-';const p=String(d).split('-');return p.length===3?`${p[2]}/${p[1]}/${p[0]}`:d}
function fmtRp(n){n=Number(n)||0;return 'Rp '+n.toLocaleString('id-ID')}
function num(n,d=2){return (Number(n)||0).toLocaleString('id-ID',{minimumFractionDigits:d,maximumFractionDigits:d})}
function int(n){return (Number(n)||0).toLocaleString('id-ID')}
function pName(id){const p=DB.projects.find(x=>x.id===id);return p?p.name:'-'}
function pCode(id){const p=DB.projects.find(x=>x.id===id);return p?p.code:'-'}
function val(id){const e=document.getElementById(id);return e?e.value:''}
function setV(id,v){const e=document.getElementById(id);if(e)e.value=v??''}
function cls(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('on')}
function opn(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.add('on')}
function stBadge(s){const m={'Draft':'b-n','Submitted':'b-a','Approved':'b-g','On Going':'b-b','Selesai':'b-g','Perencanaan':'b-n','Ditunda':'b-r'};return `<span class="badge ${m[s]||'b-n'}">${esc(s)}</span>`}

/* ================= AUTH ================= */
async function doLogin(){
  const email=val('lu').trim(),password=val('lp');
  if(!email||!password){toast('Masukkan email dan password.','er');return}
  const btn=document.querySelector('#login .btn-pri');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='MEMERIKSA...'}
  try{
    const {data,error}=await bspClient.auth.signInWithPassword({email,password});
    if(error)throw error;
    await enterApp(data.user);
    toast('Login berhasil. Data dimuat dari Supabase.','ok');
  }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Login gagal: '+(e.message||'periksa email, password, dan profil pengguna.'),'er')}
  finally{if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='MASUK'}}
}
async function logout(event){
  if(event){event.preventDefault();event.stopPropagation();}
  try{await bspClient?.auth.signOut()}catch(e){console.warn(e)}
  USER=null;DB.users=[];
  const app=document.getElementById('app'),login=document.getElementById('login');
  if(app){app.style.display='none';app.style.visibility='visible';app.removeAttribute('aria-hidden')}
  if(login){login.style.display='flex';login.style.visibility='visible';login.style.zIndex='2147483647';login.removeAttribute('aria-hidden')}
  const password=document.getElementById('lp');if(password)password.value='';
  const email=document.getElementById('lu');if(email)email.value='';
  try{toast('Anda telah keluar dari sistem.','ok')}catch(e){}
}
// Delegated capture handler keeps logout working if the sidebar is re-rendered.
document.addEventListener('click',function(e){
  const target=e.target&&e.target.closest?e.target.closest('#logoutBtn'):null;
  if(target && USER){e.preventDefault();e.stopImmediatePropagation();logout(e);}
},true);

document.getElementById('lp').addEventListener('keypress',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')doLogin()});
document.getElementById('lu').addEventListener('keypress',e=>{if(e.key==='Enter')document.getElementById('lp').focus()});

/* ================= NAV ================= */
const TITLES={dash:['Dashboard','Ringkasan kinerja seluruh proyek'],proj:['Master Proyek','Kelola data proyek perusahaan'],
daily:['Daily Report','Laporan progress harian lapangan'],weekly:['Weekly Report','Rekapitulasi progress mingguan'],
monthly:['Monthly Report','Laporan progress bulanan ke manajemen'],budget:['Budget Forecasting','Perencanaan biaya, realisasi, dan estimasi biaya akhir'],material:['Material Control','Monitoring stok, penerimaan, pemakaian, dan kebutuhan material'],hse:['HSE Monitoring','Statistik keselamatan & kesehatan kerja'],
scurve:['Kurva S & Progress','Analisa rencana vs realisasi'],export:['Export & Backup','Unduh data & cetak laporan'],setting:['Pengaturan','Konfigurasi sistem & pengguna']};
document.querySelectorAll('.nav a[data-p]').forEach(a=>a.onclick=()=>go(a.dataset.p));
function go(p){
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav a[data-p]').forEach(a=>a.classList.toggle('on',a.dataset.p===p));
  document.querySelectorAll('.page').forEach(s=>s.classList.remove('on'));
  document.getElementById('p-'+p).classList.add('on');
  document.getElementById('ptitle').childNodes[0].nodeValue=TITLES[p][0];
  document.getElementById('psub').textContent=TITLES[p][1];
  document.getElementById('sb').classList.remove('open');
  window.scrollTo(0,0);
  ({dash:renderDash,proj:renderProj,daily:renderDaily,weekly:renderWeekly,monthly:renderMonthly,budget:renderBudget,material:renderMaterial,hse:renderHSE,scurve:renderSC,export:renderExp,setting:renderSet}[p])();
}

/* ================= CHARTS (SVG) ================= */
function lineChart(el,labels,series,h=250){
  const box=document.getElementById(el);if(!box)return;
  if(!labels.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><span class="em">📊</span>Belum ada data untuk ditampilkan</div>';return}
  const W=760,H=h,pl=46,pr=16,pt=16,pb=42,cw=W-pl-pr,ch=H-pt-pb;
  let max=0;series.forEach(s=>s.data.forEach(v=>{if(v>max)max=v}));max=Math.max(max*1.1,10);
  const X=i=>pl+(labels.length>1?cw*i/(labels.length-1):cw/2), Y=v=>pt+ch-(v/max)*ch;
  let g='';for(let i=0;i<=5;i++){const y=pt+ch*i/5,v=max*(1-i/5);
    g+=`<line x1="${pl}" y1="${y}" x2="${W-pr}" y2="${y}" stroke="#E8EDF4" stroke-width="1"/><text x="${pl-7}" y="${y+4}" font-size="10" fill="#94A3B8" text-anchor="end">${v.toFixed(0)}</text>`}
  const step=Math.ceil(labels.length/9)||1;
  labels.forEach((l,i)=>{if(i%step===0||i===labels.length-1)g+=`<text x="${X(i)}" y="${H-16}" font-size="9.5" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">${esc(l)}</text>`});
  series.forEach(s=>{
    const pts=s.data.map((v,i)=>`${X(i)},${Y(v)}`).join(' ');
    if(s.fill)g+=`<polygon points="${pl},${pt+ch} ${pts} ${X(s.data.length-1)},${pt+ch}" fill="${s.color}" opacity=".10"/>`;
    g+=`<polyline points="${pts}" fill="none" stroke="${s.color}" stroke-width="2.6" stroke-linejoin="round" stroke-linecap="round"/>`;
    s.data.forEach((v,i)=>{if(i%step===0||i===s.data.length-1)g+=`<circle cx="${X(i)}" cy="${Y(v)}" r="3.6" fill="#fff" stroke="${s.color}" stroke-width="2.2"><title>${esc(labels[i])}: ${v.toFixed(2)}</title></circle>`});
  });
  box.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width:100%;height:auto">${g}</svg>`;
}
function barChart(el,items,h=250){
  const box=document.getElementById(el);if(!box)return;
  if(!items.length){box.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><span class="em">📊</span>Belum ada data proyek</div>';return}
  const it=items.slice(0,8),W=760,bh=30,gap=13,H=Math.max(it.length*(bh+gap)+22,120),lw=165;
  let g='';
  it.forEach((d,i)=>{const y=12+i*(bh+gap),bw=(W-lw-70)*Math.min(d.v,100)/100;
    const c=d.v>=80?'#16A34A':d.v>=50?'#1B4E8C':d.v>=25?'#F28C28':'#DC2626';
    const nm=d.n.length>24?d.n.substr(0,24)+'…':d.n;
    g+=`<text x="0" y="${y+20}" font-size="11.5" fill="#1A202C" font-weight="600">${esc(nm)}</text>
    <rect x="${lw}" y="${y+5}" width="${W-lw-70}" height="${bh-10}" fill="#EDF1F6" rx="5"/>
    <rect x="${lw}" y="${y+5}" width="${bw}" height="${bh-10}" fill="${c}" rx="5"><title>${esc(d.n)}: ${d.v.toFixed(1)}%</title></rect>
    <text x="${W-60}" y="${y+20}" font-size="12" fill="${c}" font-weight="700">${d.v.toFixed(1)}%</text>`});
  box.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 ${W} ${H}" style="width:100%;height:auto">${g}</svg>`;
}
function donut(el,items){
  const box=document.getElementById(el);if(!box)return;
  const tot=items.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.v,0);
  if(!tot){box.innerHTML='<div class="empty"><span class="em">🍩</span>Belum ada data</div>';return}
  const C=['#0B2A4A','#1B4E8C','#F28C28','#16A34A','#D97706','#DC2626','#7C3AED'];
  let a=-Math.PI/2,g='';const cx=100,cy=100,R=78,r=46;
  items.forEach((d,i)=>{const ang=d.v/tot*2*Math.PI,e=a+ang,lg=ang>Math.PI?1:0;
    const x1=cx+R*Math.cos(a),y1=cy+R*Math.sin(a),x2=cx+R*Math.cos(e),y2=cy+R*Math.sin(e);
    const x3=cx+r*Math.cos(e),y3=cy+r*Math.sin(e),x4=cx+r*Math.cos(a),y4=cy+r*Math.sin(a);
    g+=`<path d="M${x1},${y1} A${R},${R} 0 ${lg},1 ${x2},${y2} L${x3},${y3} A${r},${r} 0 ${lg},0 ${x4},${y4} Z" fill="${C[i%7]}"><title>${esc(d.n)}: ${d.v} (${(d.v/tot*100).toFixed(0)}%)</title></path>`;a=e});
  let lg='<div style="display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;font-size:12px;margin-top:10px">';
  items.forEach((d,i)=>lg+=`<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><i style="width:12px;height:12px;border-radius:3px;background:${C[i%7]};display:inline-block"></i><span style="flex:1">${esc(d.n)}</span><b>${d.v}</b></div>`);
  box.innerHTML=`<svg viewBox="0 0 200 200" style="width:100%;max-width:210px;display:block;margin:0 auto">${g}<text x="100" y="96" font-size="25" font-weight="800" fill="#0B2A4A" text-anchor="middle">${tot}</text><text x="100" y="114" font-size="10" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">PROYEK</text></svg>`+lg+'</div>';
}

/* ================= DASHBOARD ================= */
function renderDash(){
  const P=DB.projects;
  document.getElementById('k1').textContent=P.length;
  document.getElementById('k1b').textContent=P.filter(x=>x.status==='On Going').length+' aktif • '+P.filter(x=>x.status==='Selesai').length+' selesai';
  const avg=P.length?P.reduce((a,b)=>a+prog(b.id),0)/P.length:0;
  document.getElementById('k2').textContent=avg.toFixed(1)+'%';
  document.getElementById('k3').textContent=DB.daily.length+DB.weekly.length+DB.monthly.length;
  document.getElementById('k3b').textContent=`${DB.daily.length} D / ${DB.weekly.length} W / ${DB.monthly.length} M`;
  const mh=DB.daily.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manhours||0),0);
  document.getElementById('k4').textContent=int(mh);
  const inc=DB.daily.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.incident||0),0);
  document.getElementById('k5').textContent=inc;
  document.getElementById('k5b').textContent=inc===0?'✅ Zero Accident':'⚠️ Perlu evaluasi';

  const sel=document.getElementById('dashProj');const cur=sel.value;
  sel.innerHTML='<option value="">— Seluruh Proyek —</option>'+P.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${esc(p.code)} — ${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
  sel.value=cur;
  const rows=(sel.value?DB.daily.filter(d=>d.projectId===sel.value):DB.daily).slice().sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  const mp=new Map();
  rows.forEach(d=>{const k=d.date.substr(0,7);const o=mp.get(k)||{p:0,a:0};o.p=Math.max(o.p,+d.planCum||0);o.a=Math.max(o.a,+d.progCum||0);mp.set(k,o)});
  const lb=[...mp.keys()].map(k=>MONTHS[+k.substr(5,2)-1].substr(0,3)+' '+k.substr(2,2));
  lineChart('chartS',lb,[{data:[...mp.values()].map(v=>v.p),color:'#1B4E8C',fill:1},{data:[...mp.values()].map(v=>v.a),color:'#F28C28',fill:1}]);
  barChart('chartB',P.map(p=>({n:p.name,v:prog(p.id)})));
  const sc={};P.forEach(p=>sc[p.scope]=(sc[p.scope]||0)+1);
  donut('chartD',Object.entries(sc).map(([n,v])=>({n,v})));

  const rec=[...DB.daily.map(x=>({...x,t:'Daily',dt:x.date,pr:x.progCum,by:x.createdBy})),
    ...DB.weekly.map(x=>({...x,t:'Weekly',dt:x.dateTo,pr:x.cum,by:x.createdBy})),
    ...DB.monthly.map(x=>({...x,t:'Monthly',dt:x.year+'-'+String(x.month+1).padStart(2,'0')+'-28',pr:x.cum,by:x.createdBy}))]
    .sort((a,b)=>String(b.dt).localeCompare(String(a.dt))).slice(0,8);
  document.getElementById('recentT').innerHTML=rec.length?rec.map(r=>`<tr><td>${fmtD(r.dt)}</td>
    <td><span class="badge ${r.t==='Daily'?'b-b':r.t==='Weekly'?'b-o':'b-g'}">${r.t}</span></td>
    <td>${esc(pCode(r.projectId))}</td><td><b>${num(r.pr,1)}%</b></td><td>${esc(r.by||'-')}</td><td>${stBadge(r.status)}</td></tr>`).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty"><span class="em">📄</span>Belum ada laporan. Mulai dengan membuat Daily Report.</div></td></tr>';
}
function prog(pid){
  const d=DB.daily.filter(x=>x.projectId===pid);
  if(d.length){return Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.progCum||0))}
  const m=DB.monthly.filter(x=>x.projectId===pid);
  if(m.length)return Math.max(...m.map(x=>+x.cum||0));
  const w=DB.weekly.filter(x=>x.projectId===pid);
  if(w.length)return Math.max(...w.map(x=>+x.cum||0));
  return 0;
}

/* ================= PROYEK ================= */
function renderProj(){
  const q=val('fProjQ').toLowerCase(),s=val('fProjS'),st=val('fProjSt');
  const d=DB.projects.filter(p=>(!q||(p.name+p.code+p.client).toLowerCase().includes(q))&&(!s||p.scope===s)&&(!st||p.status===st));
  document.getElementById('projT').innerHTML=d.length?d.map(p=>{const pr=prog(p.id);return `<tr>
    <td><b>${esc(p.code)}</b></td><td>${esc(p.name)}<br><small style="color:var(--muted)">PM: ${esc(p.pm||'-')}</small></td>
    <td>${esc(p.client||'-')}</td><td><span class="badge b-b">${esc(p.scope)}</span></td><td>${esc(p.location||'-')}</td>
    <td style="font-size:11.5px">${fmtD(p.start)}<br>s/d ${fmtD(p.end)}</td><td>${fmtRp(p.value)}</td>
    <td><div class="pbar"><i style="width:${Math.min(pr,100)}%"></i></div><small><b>${num(pr,1)}%</b> / plan ${num(p.plan,0)}%</small></td>
    <td>${stBadge(p.status)}</td>
    <td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="openProj('${p.id}')">✏️</button> <button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="delItem('projects','${p.id}')">🗑️</button></td></tr>`}).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty"><span class="em">🏗️</span>Belum ada proyek.<br>Klik <b>Tambah Proyek</b> untuk menambahkan data proyek resmi.</div></td></tr>';
  fillProjSel();
}
function fillProjSel(){
  const o=DB.projects.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${esc(p.code)} — ${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join('');
  ['dProj','wProj','mProjS'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e){const v=e.value;e.innerHTML=o;e.value=v}});
  ['fdProj','fwProj','fmProj'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e){const v=e.value;e.innerHTML='<option value="">Semua Proyek</option>'+o;e.value=v}});
  ['scProj','prProj'].forEach(i=>{const e=document.getElementById(i);if(e){const v=e.value;e.innerHTML='<option value="">— Seluruh Proyek —</option>'+o;e.value=v}});
  const y=document.getElementById('fmYear');if(y){const ys=[...new Set(DB.monthly.map(m=>m.year))].sort();const v=y.value;y.innerHTML='<option value="">Semua Tahun</option>'+ys.map(x=>`<option>${x}</option>`).join('');y.value=v}
}
function openProj(id){
  ['pjId','pjCode','pjName','pjClient','pjLoc','pjStart','pjEnd','pjVal','pjTv','pjPm','pjNote','pjAccessUser','pjAccessPass'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));
  setV('pjAccessRole','viewer');
  setV('pjPlan',0);setV('pjSt','Perencanaan');setV('pjScope','SACME');
  document.getElementById('mProjT').textContent='Tambah Proyek Baru';
  if(id){const p=DB.projects.find(x=>x.id===id);if(p){
    document.getElementById('mProjT').textContent='Edit Proyek — '+p.code;
    setV('pjId',p.id);setV('pjCode',p.code);setV('pjName',p.name);setV('pjClient',p.client);setV('pjScope',p.scope);
    setV('pjLoc',p.location);setV('pjStart',p.start);setV('pjEnd',p.end);setV('pjVal',p.value);setV('pjTv',p.targetVol);
    setV('pjUnit',p.unit);setV('pjSt',p.status);setV('pjPm',p.pm);setV('pjPlan',p.plan);setV('pjNote',p.note);setV('pjAccessUser',p.accessUser||'');setV('pjAccessPass',p.accessPass||'');setV('pjAccessRole',p.accessRole||'viewer')}}
  else setV('pjCode','BSP-'+new Date().getFullYear()+'-'+String(DB.projects.length+1).padStart(3,'0'));
  opn('mProj');
}
function saveProj(){
  if(!val('pjCode').trim()||!val('pjName').trim()){toast('Kode dan Nama Proyek wajib diisi!','er');return}
  const code=val('pjCode').trim();
  if(DB.projects.some(p=>p.code.toLowerCase()===code.toLowerCase()&&p.id!==val('pjId'))){toast('Kode proyek sudah digunakan. Gunakan kode yang berbeda.','er');return}
  const plan=Number(val('pjPlan')||0);
  if(plan<0||plan>100){toast('Progress rencana harus antara 0 dan 100%.','er');return}
  const o={id:val('pjId')||uid(),code,name:val('pjName').trim(),client:val('pjClient'),scope:val('pjScope'),
    location:val('pjLoc'),start:val('pjStart'),end:val('pjEnd'),value:+val('pjVal')||0,targetVol:+val('pjTv')||0,
    unit:val('pjUnit'),status:val('pjSt'),pm:val('pjPm'),plan:+val('pjPlan')||0,note:val('pjNote'),
    accessUser:val('pjAccessUser').trim(),accessPass:val('pjAccessPass'),accessRole:val('pjAccessRole')||'viewer'};
  const i=DB.projects.findIndex(x=>x.id===o.id);
  i>=0?DB.projects[i]=o:DB.projects.push(o);
  save();cls('mProj');renderProj();toast('Proyek berhasil disimpan!','ok');
}
function delItem(coll,id){
  if(coll==='users'){deleteCloudUser(id);return}
  if(!DB[coll]||!Array.isArray(DB[coll])){toast('Data yang akan dihapus tidak ditemukan.','er');return}
  if(USER?.role!=='admin'&&coll==='projects'){toast('Hanya Administrator yang dapat menghapus proyek.','er');return}
  const item=DB[coll].find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));
  if(!item){toast('Data sudah tidak tersedia. Muat ulang daftar untuk menyinkronkan tampilan.','er');return}
  const label=coll==='projects'?`proyek ${item.code||item.name||''}`:'data ini';
  if(!confirm(`Yakin ingin menghapus ${label}? Tindakan tidak dapat dibatalkan.`))return;
  if(coll==='projects'){
    // Hapus proyek beserta data turunannya agar tidak menjadi referensi yatim.
    DB.projects=DB.projects.filter(x=>String(x.id)!==String(id));
    ['daily','weekly','monthly','budgets','materials'].forEach(k=>{
      if(Array.isArray(DB[k]))DB[k]=DB[k].filter(x=>String(x.projectId)!==String(id));
    });
  }else{
    DB[coll]=DB[coll].filter(x=>String(x.id)!==String(id));
  }
  const persisted=save();
  if(coll==='projects'){
    renderProj();
    ['renderDaily','renderWeekly','renderMonthly','renderBudget','renderMaterials','renderCorrelation'].forEach(fn=>{
      if(typeof window[fn]==='function'){try{window[fn]()}catch(e){console.warn('Refresh '+fn,e)}}
    });
    if(typeof fillOpsProject==='function'){
      ['bProject','mProject','corrProject'].forEach(k=>{try{fillOpsProject(k)}catch(e){}});
      try{renderCorrelation()}catch(e){}
    }
  }else{
    const refresh={daily:renderDaily,weekly:renderWeekly,monthly:renderMonthly,users:renderSet,budgets:()=>{if(typeof renderBudget==='function')renderBudget()},materials:()=>{if(typeof renderMaterials==='function')renderMaterials()}};
    if(refresh[coll])refresh[coll]();
  }
  if(persisted)toast('Data berhasil dihapus dan perubahan tersimpan.','wr');
  else toast('Data dihapus pada tampilan ini, tetapi gagal disimpan ke browser. Periksa penyimpanan browser lalu coba lagi.','er');
}

/* ================= DAILY ================= */
function openDaily(id){
  PHOTOS=[];['dId','dLoc','dDay','dIssue','dSol','dNext','dHseNote','dEqOther','dChk'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));
  ['dmSv','dmTk','dmHp','dmOp','dNm','dInc','dTbmP','dPrgD','dPrgC','dPrgP'].forEach(i=>setV(i,0));
  setV('dmJam',8);setV('dDate',localISODate());setV('dBy',USER.name);setV('dSt','Draft');setV('dTbm','1');setV('dHour','08:00 - 17:00');
  document.getElementById('dActT').innerHTML='';document.getElementById('dMatT').innerHTML='';
  document.getElementById('dEquip').innerHTML=EQUIPS.map(e=>`<span class="chip" onclick="this.classList.toggle('on')">${e}</span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('mDailyT').textContent='Daily Progress Report — Baru';
  addAct();addMat();
  if(id){const d=DB.daily.find(x=>x.id===id);if(d){
    document.getElementById('mDailyT').textContent='Edit Daily Report — '+fmtD(d.date);
    setV('dId',d.id);setV('dProj',d.projectId);setV('dDate',d.date);setV('dDay',d.dayNo);setV('dLoc',d.location);
    setV('dWth',d.weather);setV('dHour',d.hours);setV('dmSv',d.mSv);setV('dmTk',d.mTk);setV('dmHp',d.mHp);setV('dmOp',d.mOp);
    setV('dmJam',d.jam);setV('dPrgD',d.progDay);setV('dPrgC',d.progCum);setV('dPrgP',d.planCum);
    setV('dTbm',d.tbm?'1':'0');setV('dTbmP',d.tbmP);setV('dNm',d.nearMiss);setV('dInc',d.incident);setV('dHseNote',d.hseNote);
    setV('dIssue',d.issue);setV('dSol',d.solution);setV('dNext',d.nextPlan);setV('dBy',d.createdBy);setV('dChk',d.checkedBy);setV('dSt',d.status);
    setV('dEqOther',d.eqOther);PHOTOS=d.photos||[];
    document.getElementById('dActT').innerHTML='';(d.activities||[]).forEach(a=>addAct(a));if(!(d.activities||[]).length)addAct();
    document.getElementById('dMatT').innerHTML='';(d.materials||[]).forEach(m=>addMat(m));if(!(d.materials||[]).length)addMat();
    document.querySelectorAll('#dEquip .chip').forEach(c=>{if((d.equipment||[]).includes(c.textContent))c.classList.add('on')});
    drawPhotos();}}
  calcMP();opn('mDaily');
}
function calcMP(){
  const t=(+val('dmSv')||0)+(+val('dmTk')||0)+(+val('dmHp')||0)+(+val('dmOp')||0);
  setV('dmTot',t);setV('dmMh',(t*(+val('dmJam')||0)).toFixed(0));
}
function addAct(a={}){document.getElementById('dActT').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
  `<tr><td><input value="${esc(a.d||'')}" placeholder="Contoh: Penarikan kabel FO ADSS 24 core"></td><td><input type="number" step="0.01" value="${a.v||''}" placeholder="0"></td>
   <td><select><option>m</option><option>km</option><option>unit</option><option>titik</option><option>core</option><option>m³</option><option>m²</option><option>ls</option><option>site</option></select></td>
   <td><input value="${esc(a.k||'')}" placeholder="Ket."></td><td><button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove()">✕</button></td></tr>`);
  if(a.u){const r=document.getElementById('dActT').lastElementChild;r.querySelectorAll('select')[0].value=a.u}}
function addMat(m={}){document.getElementById('dMatT').insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend',
  `<tr><td><input value="${esc(m.n||'')}" placeholder="Contoh: Kabel FO ADSS 24 Core"></td><td><input type="number" step="0.01" value="${m.q||''}" placeholder="0"></td>
   <td><input value="${esc(m.u||'')}" placeholder="m / pcs"></td><td><input value="${esc(m.s||'')}" placeholder="Sisa"></td>
   <td><button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="this.closest('tr').remove()">✕</button></td></tr>`)}
function addPhoto(e){
  const fs=[...e.target.files].slice(0,6-PHOTOS.length);
  fs.forEach(f=>{const r=new FileReader();r.onload=ev=>{
    const img=new Image();img.onload=()=>{
      const c=document.createElement('canvas');const mx=760;let w=img.width,h=img.height;
      if(w>mx){h=h*mx/w;w=mx}c.width=w;c.height=h;c.getContext('2d').drawImage(img,0,0,w,h);
      PHOTOS.push(c.toDataURL('image/jpeg',.55));drawPhotos()};img.src=ev.target.result};r.readAsDataURL(f)});
  e.target.value='';
}
function drawPhotos(){document.getElementById('dPhotos').innerHTML=PHOTOS.map((p,i)=>
  `<div class="thumb-w"><img src="${p}" class="thumb"><button onclick="PHOTOS.splice(${i},1);drawPhotos()">×</button></div>`).join('')}
function saveDaily(){
  if(!val('dProj')){toast('Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu!','er');return}
  if(!val('dDate')){toast('Tanggal laporan wajib diisi!','er');return}
  const acts=[...document.querySelectorAll('#dActT tr')].map(r=>{const i=r.querySelectorAll('input'),s=r.querySelector('select');
    return{d:i[0].value,v:i[1].value,u:s.value,k:i[2].value}}).filter(x=>x.d);
  const mats=[...document.querySelectorAll('#dMatT tr')].map(r=>{const i=r.querySelectorAll('input');
    return{n:i[0].value,q:i[1].value,u:i[2].value,s:i[3].value}}).filter(x=>x.n);
  const eq=[...document.querySelectorAll('#dEquip .chip.on')].map(c=>c.textContent);
  const o={id:val('dId')||uid(),projectId:val('dProj'),date:val('dDate'),dayNo:val('dDay'),location:val('dLoc'),
    weather:val('dWth'),hours:val('dHour'),mSv:+val('dmSv'),mTk:+val('dmTk'),mHp:+val('dmHp'),mOp:+val('dmOp'),
    manpower:+val('dmTot'),jam:+val('dmJam'),manhours:+val('dmMh'),equipment:eq,eqOther:val('dEqOther'),
    activities:acts,materials:mats,progDay:+val('dPrgD'),progCum:+val('dPrgC'),planCum:+val('dPrgP'),
    tbm:val('dTbm')==='1',tbmP:+val('dTbmP'),nearMiss:+val('dNm'),incident:+val('dInc'),hseNote:val('dHseNote'),
    issue:val('dIssue'),solution:val('dSol'),nextPlan:val('dNext'),photos:PHOTOS,
    createdBy:val('dBy'),checkedBy:val('dChk'),status:val('dSt'),ts:Date.now()};
  const i=DB.daily.findIndex(x=>x.id===o.id);i>=0?DB.daily[i]=o:DB.daily.push(o);
  save();cls('mDaily');renderDaily();toast('Daily Report berhasil disimpan!','ok');
}
function fDaily(){
  const p=val('fdProj'),f=val('fdFrom'),t=val('fdTo'),q=val('fdQ').toLowerCase();
  return DB.daily.filter(d=>(!p||d.projectId===p)&&(!f||d.date>=f)&&(!t||d.date<=t)&&
    (!q||JSON.stringify(d.activities||[]).toLowerCase().includes(q)||(d.location||'').toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    .sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date));
}
function renderDaily(){
  const d=fDaily();
  document.getElementById('dS1').textContent=d.length;
  document.getElementById('dS2').textContent=int(d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manpower||0),0));
  document.getElementById('dS3').textContent=int(d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manhours||0),0));
  document.getElementById('dS4').textContent=d.filter(x=>x.issue&&x.issue.trim()).length;
  document.getElementById('dailyT').innerHTML=d.length?d.map(x=>`<tr>
    <td><b>${fmtD(x.date)}</b>${x.dayNo?`<br><small style="color:var(--muted)">Hari ke-${x.dayNo}</small>`:''}</td>
    <td>${esc(pCode(x.projectId))}</td><td style="font-size:12px">${esc(x.location||'-')}</td><td style="font-size:12px">${esc(x.weather||'-')}</td>
    <td>${x.manpower||0}</td><td>${int(x.manhours)}</td><td><b style="color:var(--green)">+${num(x.progDay,2)}%</b></td>
    <td><div class="pbar"><i style="width:${Math.min(x.progCum,100)}%"></i></div><small>${num(x.progCum,2)}%</small></td>
    <td>${stBadge(x.status)}</td>
    <td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="viewDaily('${x.id}')">👁️</button> <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="openDaily('${x.id}')">✏️</button> <button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="delItem('daily','${x.id}')">🗑️</button></td></tr>`).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="10"><div class="empty"><span class="em">📅</span>Belum ada laporan harian pada filter ini.</div></td></tr>';
}
function clearF(t){
  if(t==='d'){['fdProj','fdFrom','fdTo','fdQ'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));renderDaily()}
  if(t==='w'){['fwProj','fwQ'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));renderWeekly()}
  if(t==='m'){['fmProj','fmYear'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));renderMonthly()}
}
function viewDaily(id){
  const d=DB.daily.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!d)return;
  document.getElementById('vTitle').textContent='Daily Report — '+fmtD(d.date);
  document.getElementById('vBody').innerHTML=rptHead('LAPORAN HARIAN PROYEK (DAILY PROGRESS REPORT)')+`
  <div class="sect"><h4>Informasi Umum</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Proyek</dt><dd><b>${esc(pCode(d.projectId))}</b> — ${esc(pName(d.projectId))}</dd>
    <dt>Tanggal</dt><dd>${fmtD(d.date)} ${d.dayNo?'(Hari ke-'+d.dayNo+')':''}</dd>
    <dt>Lokasi</dt><dd>${esc(d.location||'-')}</dd><dt>Cuaca</dt><dd>${esc(d.weather||'-')}</dd>
    <dt>Jam Kerja</dt><dd>${esc(d.hours||'-')}</dd><dt>Status</dt><dd>${stBadge(d.status)}</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Tenaga Kerja</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Supervisor</dt><dd>${d.mSv||0} orang</dd><dt>Teknisi</dt><dd>${d.mTk||0} orang</dd>
    <dt>Helper</dt><dd>${d.mHp||0} orang</dd><dt>Operator</dt><dd>${d.mOp||0} orang</dd>
    <dt>Total MP</dt><dd><b>${d.manpower||0} orang</b></dd><dt>Total Manhours</dt><dd><b style="color:var(--orange)">${int(d.manhours)} jam-orang</b></dd></dl></div>
  ${(d.activities||[]).length?`<div class="sect"><h4>Uraian Pekerjaan</h4><table class="mini-tbl"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Aktivitas</th><th>Volume</th><th>Sat.</th><th>Ket.</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${d.activities.map((a,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${esc(a.d)}</td><td>${esc(a.v)}</td><td>${esc(a.u)}</td><td>${esc(a.k)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`:''}
  ${(d.materials||[]).length?`<div class="sect"><h4>Material Terpakai</h4><table class="mini-tbl"><thead><tr><th>No</th><th>Material</th><th>Qty</th><th>Sat.</th><th>Sisa</th></tr></thead><tbody>
    ${d.materials.map((m,i)=>`<tr><td>${i+1}</td><td>${esc(m.n)}</td><td>${esc(m.q)}</td><td>${esc(m.u)}</td><td>${esc(m.s)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</tbody></table></div>`:''}
  ${(d.equipment||[]).length||d.eqOther?`<div class="sect"><h4>Peralatan</h4><div>${(d.equipment||[]).map(e=>`<span class="badge b-b" style="margin:2px">${esc(e)}</span>`).join('')} ${esc(d.eqOther||'')}</div></div>`:''}
  <div class="sect"><h4>Progress</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Progress Hari Ini</dt><dd><b style="color:var(--green)">+${num(d.progDay,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Kumulatif Aktual</dt><dd><b>${num(d.progCum,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Kumulatif Rencana</dt><dd>${num(d.planCum,2)}%</dd>
    <dt>Deviasi</dt><dd><b style="color:${(d.progCum-d.planCum)>=0?'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}">${(d.progCum-d.planCum)>=0?'+':''}${num(d.progCum-d.planCum,2)}%</b></dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Keselamatan Kerja (HSE)</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Toolbox Meeting</dt><dd>${d.tbm?'✅ Dilaksanakan ('+(d.tbmP||0)+' peserta)':'❌ Tidak dilaksanakan'}</dd>
    <dt>Near Miss</dt><dd>${d.nearMiss||0}</dd><dt>Incident / LTI</dt><dd>${d.incident||0}</dd>
    <dt>Catatan</dt><dd>${nl(d.hseNote||'-')}</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Kendala & Rencana</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Kendala</dt><dd>${nl(d.issue||'Tidak ada kendala')}</dd>
    <dt>Solusi</dt><dd>${nl(d.solution||'-')}</dd>
    <dt>Rencana Besok</dt><dd>${nl(d.nextPlan||'-')}</dd></dl></div>
  ${(d.photos||[]).length?`<div class="sect"><h4>Dokumentasi Foto</h4><div class="thumbs">${d.photos.map(p=>`<img src="${p}" style="width:150px;height:112px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid #ddd">`).join('')}</div></div>`:''}
  ${sign(d.createdBy,d.checkedBy)}`;
  opn('mView');
}
function rptHead(t){
  const s=DB.settings;
  return `<div style="text-align:center;border-bottom:3px double var(--navy);padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:18px">
    <div style="font-size:16px;font-weight:800;color:var(--navy);letter-spacing:.5px">${esc(s.name)}</div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted);margin:3px 0">${esc(s.address)}</div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:var(--muted)">Telp: ${esc(s.phone)} • Email: ${esc(s.email)}</div>
