    <div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:14px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px;color:var(--navy)">${t}</div></div>`;
}
function sign(a,b){
  return `<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;margin-top:26px;text-align:center;font-size:12.5px">
    <div><div style="color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:56px">Dibuat Oleh,</div><div style="border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:5px"><b>${esc(a||'..................')}</b></div></div>
    <div><div style="color:var(--muted);margin-bottom:56px">Diperiksa / Disetujui,</div><div style="border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:5px"><b>${esc(b||'..................')}</b></div></div></div>`;
}
function printView(){
  const w=window.open('','_blank');
  if(!w){toast('Popup diblokir browser. Izinkan popup untuk mencetak laporan.','wr');return}
  w.document.write(`<html><head><title>Laporan BSP</title><style>
  body{font-family:Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;padding:22px;color:#111}
  .sect{border:1px solid #ccc;border-radius:7px;padding:12px;margin-bottom:12px;page-break-inside:avoid}
  .sect>h4{font-size:11px;text-transform:uppercase;border-bottom:2px solid #F28C28;display:inline-block;margin-bottom:9px;padding-bottom:4px;color:#0B2A4A}
  .detail-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:155px 1fr;gap:6px 12px}
  .detail-grid dt{font-weight:bold;color:#555;font-size:10.5px;text-transform:uppercase}
  table{width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:11px;margin-top:6px}
  th{background:#0B2A4A;color:#fff;padding:6px;text-align:left}td{padding:5px;border-bottom:1px solid #eee}
  .badge{padding:2px 7px;border-radius:10px;font-size:10px;background:#eee;display:inline-block}
  img{max-width:150px;border-radius:5px;margin:3px}.thumbs{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px}
  </style></head><body>${document.getElementById('vBody').innerHTML}</body></html>`);
  w.document.close();setTimeout(()=>w.print(),450);
}

/* ================= WEEKLY ================= */
function openWeekly(id){
  ['wId','wDone','wVol','wIssue','wMit','wNext','wHse','wApp'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));
  ['wPlan','wAct','wCum','wDays','wMp','wMh','wRain','wTbm','wNm','wInc','wNcr'].forEach(i=>setV(i,0));
  setV('wBy',USER.name);setV('wSt','Draft');setV('wNo',DB.weekly.length+1);setV('wDev','0.00');
  const t=new Date(),dow=t.getDay()||7,mon=new Date(t);mon.setDate(t.getDate()-dow+1);const sun=new Date(mon);sun.setDate(mon.getDate()+6);
  setV('wFrom',mon.toISOString().substr(0,10));setV('wTo',sun.toISOString().substr(0,10));
  document.getElementById('mWeeklyT').textContent='Weekly Progress Report — Baru';
  if(id){const w=DB.weekly.find(x=>x.id===id);if(w){
    document.getElementById('mWeeklyT').textContent='Edit Weekly Report — Minggu ke-'+w.weekNo;
    setV('wId',w.id);setV('wProj',w.projectId);setV('wNo',w.weekNo);setV('wFrom',w.dateFrom);setV('wTo',w.dateTo);
    setV('wPlan',w.plan);setV('wAct',w.actual);setV('wCum',w.cum);setV('wDays',w.days);setV('wMp',w.mp);setV('wMh',w.mh);
    setV('wRain',w.rain);setV('wDone',w.done);setV('wVol',w.vol);setV('wIssue',w.issue);setV('wMit',w.mitigation);
    setV('wNext',w.next);setV('wTbm',w.tbm);setV('wNm',w.nearMiss);setV('wInc',w.incident);setV('wNcr',w.ncr);
    setV('wHse',w.hse);setV('wBy',w.createdBy);setV('wApp',w.approvedBy);setV('wSt',w.status);calcDev()}}
  opn('mWeekly');
}
function calcDev(){const d=(+val('wAct')||0)-(+val('wPlan')||0);setV('wDev',(d>=0?'+':'')+d.toFixed(2))}
function calcMDev(){const d=(+val('mAct')||0)-(+val('mPlan')||0);setV('mDev',(d>=0?'+':'')+d.toFixed(2))}
function autoWeek(force){
  const p=val('wProj'),f=val('wFrom'),t=val('wTo');
  if(!p||!f||!t){if(force)toast('Pilih proyek dan rentang tanggal terlebih dahulu.','wr');return}
  const d=DB.daily.filter(x=>x.projectId===p&&x.date>=f&&x.date<=t);
  if(!d.length){if(force)toast('Tidak ada Daily Report pada rentang tanggal tersebut.','wr');return}
  setV('wDays',d.length);
  setV('wMh',d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manhours||0),0));
  setV('wMp',Math.round(d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manpower||0),0)/d.length));
  setV('wAct',d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.progDay||0),0).toFixed(2));
  setV('wCum',Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.progCum||0)).toFixed(2));
  setV('wPlan',Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.planCum||0)).toFixed(2));
  setV('wRain',d.filter(x=>(x.weather||'').includes('Hujan')).length);
  setV('wTbm',d.filter(x=>x.tbm).length);
  setV('wNm',d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.nearMiss||0),0));
  setV('wInc',d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.incident||0),0));
  const acts=[];d.forEach(x=>(x.activities||[]).forEach(a=>{if(a.d)acts.push(`• ${a.d}${a.v?` — ${a.v} ${a.u}`:''}`)}));
  setV('wDone',[...new Set(acts)].slice(0,18).join('\n'));
  const iss=d.filter(x=>x.issue&&x.issue.trim()).map(x=>`[${fmtD(x.date)}] ${x.issue}`);
  setV('wIssue',iss.join('\n'));
  const sol=d.filter(x=>x.solution&&x.solution.trim()).map(x=>`[${fmtD(x.date)}] ${x.solution}`);
  setV('wMit',sol.join('\n'));
  calcDev();if(force)toast(`Berhasil menarik ${d.length} laporan harian.`,'ok');
}
function saveWeekly(){
  if(!val('wProj')){toast('Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu!','er');return}
  const o={id:val('wId')||uid(),projectId:val('wProj'),weekNo:+val('wNo'),dateFrom:val('wFrom'),dateTo:val('wTo'),
    plan:+val('wPlan'),actual:+val('wAct'),cum:+val('wCum'),days:+val('wDays'),mp:+val('wMp'),mh:+val('wMh'),rain:+val('wRain'),
    done:val('wDone'),vol:val('wVol'),issue:val('wIssue'),mitigation:val('wMit'),next:val('wNext'),
    tbm:+val('wTbm'),nearMiss:+val('wNm'),incident:+val('wInc'),ncr:+val('wNcr'),hse:val('wHse'),
    createdBy:val('wBy'),approvedBy:val('wApp'),status:val('wSt'),ts:Date.now()};
  const i=DB.weekly.findIndex(x=>x.id===o.id);i>=0?DB.weekly[i]=o:DB.weekly.push(o);
  save();cls('mWeekly');renderWeekly();toast('Weekly Report berhasil disimpan!','ok');
}
function renderWeekly(){
  const p=val('fwProj'),q=val('fwQ').toLowerCase();
  const d=DB.weekly.filter(w=>(!p||w.projectId===p)&&(!q||(w.done+w.issue+w.next).toLowerCase().includes(q)))
    .sort((a,b)=>String(b.dateFrom).localeCompare(String(a.dateFrom)));
  document.getElementById('weeklyT').innerHTML=d.length?d.map(w=>{const dv=w.actual-w.plan;return `<tr>
    <td><b>Minggu ${w.weekNo}</b></td><td style="font-size:11.5px">${fmtD(w.dateFrom)}<br>s/d ${fmtD(w.dateTo)}</td>
    <td>${esc(pCode(w.projectId))}</td><td>${num(w.plan,2)}%</td><td><b>${num(w.actual,2)}%</b></td>
    <td><span class="badge ${dv>=0?'b-g':'b-r'}">${dv>=0?'+':''}${num(dv,2)}%</span></td>
    <td>${int(w.mh)}</td><td>${stBadge(w.status)}</td>
    <td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="viewWeekly('${w.id}')">👁️</button> <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="openWeekly('${w.id}')">✏️</button> <button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="delItem('weekly','${w.id}')">🗑️</button></td></tr>`}).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty"><span class="em">📆</span>Belum ada laporan mingguan.</div></td></tr>';
}
function viewWeekly(id){
  const w=DB.weekly.find(x=>x.id===id);if(!w)return;const dv=w.actual-w.plan;
  document.getElementById('vTitle').textContent='Weekly Report — Minggu ke-'+w.weekNo;
  document.getElementById('vBody').innerHTML=rptHead('LAPORAN MINGGUAN PROYEK (WEEKLY PROGRESS REPORT)')+`
  <div class="sect"><h4>Periode Pelaporan</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Proyek</dt><dd><b>${esc(pCode(w.projectId))}</b> — ${esc(pName(w.projectId))}</dd>
    <dt>Minggu Ke-</dt><dd>${w.weekNo}</dd><dt>Periode</dt><dd>${fmtD(w.dateFrom)} s/d ${fmtD(w.dateTo)}</dd>
    <dt>Hari Kerja</dt><dd>${w.days} hari (${w.rain} hari hujan)</dd><dt>Status</dt><dd>${stBadge(w.status)}</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Capaian Progress</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Rencana</dt><dd>${num(w.plan,2)}%</dd><dt>Realisasi</dt><dd><b>${num(w.actual,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Deviasi</dt><dd><b style="color:${dv>=0?'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}">${dv>=0?'+':''}${num(dv,2)}% — ${dv>=0?'AHEAD/ON SCHEDULE':'BEHIND SCHEDULE'}</b></dd>
    <dt>Kumulatif</dt><dd><b>${num(w.cum,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Volume Capaian</dt><dd>${esc(w.vol||'-')}</dd>
    <dt>Manpower</dt><dd>${w.mp} orang/hari • ${int(w.mh)} manhours</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Pekerjaan Diselesaikan</h4><div>${nl(w.done||'-')}</div></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Kendala & Mitigasi</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Kendala</dt><dd>${nl(w.issue||'Tidak ada')}</dd><dt>Mitigasi</dt><dd>${nl(w.mitigation||'-')}</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Rencana Minggu Depan</h4><div>${nl(w.next||'-')}</div></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>HSE & Mutu</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Toolbox Meeting</dt><dd>${w.tbm} sesi</dd><dt>Near Miss</dt><dd>${w.nearMiss}</dd>
    <dt>Incident</dt><dd>${w.incident}</dd><dt>NCR Mutu</dt><dd>${w.ncr}</dd>
    <dt>Catatan</dt><dd>${nl(w.hse||'-')}</dd></dl></div>
  ${sign(w.createdBy,w.approvedBy)}`;
  opn('mView');
}

/* ================= MONTHLY ================= */
function openMonthly(id){
  ['mId','mDone','mIssue','mCorr','mNext','mRec','mApp'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));
  ['mPlan','mAct','mCum','mFp','mFa','mFc','mFpct','mDays','mMh','mMp','mRep','mSmh','mTbm','mNm','mInc'].forEach(i=>setV(i,0));
  document.getElementById('mMon').innerHTML=MONTHS.map((m,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${m}</option>`).join('');
  const n=new Date();setV('mMon',n.getMonth());setV('mYr',n.getFullYear());setV('mBy',USER.name);setV('mSt','Draft');setV('mDev','0.00');
  document.getElementById('mMonthlyT').textContent='Monthly Progress Report — Baru';
  if(id){const m=DB.monthly.find(x=>x.id===id);if(m){
    document.getElementById('mMonthlyT').textContent=`Edit Monthly Report — ${MONTHS[m.month]} ${m.year}`;
    setV('mId',m.id);setV('mProjS',m.projectId);setV('mMon',m.month);setV('mYr',m.year);
    setV('mPlan',m.plan);setV('mAct',m.actual);setV('mCum',m.cum);setV('mFp',m.finPlan);setV('mFa',m.finAct);
    setV('mFc',m.finCost);setV('mFpct',m.finPct);setV('mDays',m.days);setV('mMh',m.mh);setV('mMp',m.mp);setV('mRep',m.reports);
    setV('mDone',m.done);setV('mIssue',m.issue);setV('mCorr',m.corrective);setV('mNext',m.next);setV('mRec',m.recom);
    setV('mSmh',m.safeMh);setV('mTbm',m.tbm);setV('mNm',m.nearMiss);setV('mInc',m.incident);
    setV('mBy',m.createdBy);setV('mApp',m.approvedBy);setV('mSt',m.status);calcMDev()}}
  opn('mMonthly');
}
function autoMonth(){
  const p=val('mProjS'),mo=+val('mMon'),yr=+val('mYr');
  if(!p){toast('Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu.','wr');return}
  const pre=yr+'-'+String(mo+1).padStart(2,'0');
  const d=DB.daily.filter(x=>x.projectId===p&&x.date.startsWith(pre));
  if(!d.length){toast('Tidak ada Daily Report pada bulan tersebut.','wr');return}
  setV('mDays',d.length);setV('mRep',d.length);
  const mh=d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manhours||0),0);
  setV('mMh',mh);setV('mMp',Math.round(d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manpower||0),0)/d.length));
  setV('mAct',d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.progDay||0),0).toFixed(2));
  setV('mCum',Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.progCum||0)).toFixed(2));
  setV('mPlan',Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.planCum||0)).toFixed(2));
  setV('mTbm',d.filter(x=>x.tbm).length);
  setV('mNm',d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.nearMiss||0),0));
  const inc=d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.incident||0),0);setV('mInc',inc);setV('mSmh',inc===0?mh:0);
  const acts=[];d.forEach(x=>(x.activities||[]).forEach(a=>{if(a.d)acts.push('• '+a.d)}));
  setV('mDone',[...new Set(acts)].slice(0,20).join('\n'));
  setV('mIssue',d.filter(x=>x.issue&&x.issue.trim()).map(x=>`[${fmtD(x.date)}] ${x.issue}`).slice(0,15).join('\n'));
  calcMDev();toast(`Berhasil menarik ${d.length} laporan harian bulan ${MONTHS[mo]}.`,'ok');
}
function saveMonthly(){
  if(!val('mProjS')){toast('Pilih proyek terlebih dahulu!','er');return}
  const o={id:val('mId')||uid(),projectId:val('mProjS'),month:+val('mMon'),year:+val('mYr'),
    plan:+val('mPlan'),actual:+val('mAct'),cum:+val('mCum'),finPlan:+val('mFp'),finAct:+val('mFa'),finCost:+val('mFc'),finPct:+val('mFpct'),
    days:+val('mDays'),mh:+val('mMh'),mp:+val('mMp'),reports:+val('mRep'),done:val('mDone'),issue:val('mIssue'),
    corrective:val('mCorr'),next:val('mNext'),recom:val('mRec'),safeMh:+val('mSmh'),tbm:+val('mTbm'),
    nearMiss:+val('mNm'),incident:+val('mInc'),createdBy:val('mBy'),approvedBy:val('mApp'),status:val('mSt'),ts:Date.now()};
  const i=DB.monthly.findIndex(x=>x.id===o.id);i>=0?DB.monthly[i]=o:DB.monthly.push(o);
  save();cls('mMonthly');renderMonthly();toast('Monthly Report berhasil disimpan!','ok');
}
function renderMonthly(){
  const p=val('fmProj'),y=val('fmYear');
  const d=DB.monthly.filter(m=>(!p||m.projectId===p)&&(!y||String(m.year)===y))
    .sort((a,b)=>(b.year-a.year)||(b.month-a.month));
  document.getElementById('monthlyT').innerHTML=d.length?d.map(m=>{const dv=m.actual-m.plan;return `<tr>
    <td><b>${MONTHS[m.month]} ${m.year}</b></td><td>${esc(pCode(m.projectId))}</td>
    <td>${num(m.plan,2)}%</td><td><b>${num(m.actual,2)}%</b></td>
    <td><span class="badge ${dv>=0?'b-g':'b-r'}">${dv>=0?'+':''}${num(dv,2)}%</span></td>
    <td style="font-size:11.5px">${fmtRp(m.finPlan)}</td><td style="font-size:11.5px"><b>${fmtRp(m.finAct)}</b></td>
    <td>${stBadge(m.status)}</td>
    <td style="white-space:nowrap"><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="viewMonthly('${m.id}')">👁️</button> <button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="openMonthly('${m.id}')">✏️</button> <button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="delItem('monthly','${m.id}')">🗑️</button></td></tr>`}).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty"><span class="em">🗓️</span>Belum ada laporan bulanan.</div></td></tr>';
  fillProjSel();
}
function viewMonthly(m_id){
  const m=DB.monthly.find(x=>x.id===m_id);if(!m)return;const dv=m.actual-m.plan;
  document.getElementById('vTitle').textContent=`Monthly Report — ${MONTHS[m.month]} ${m.year}`;
  document.getElementById('vBody').innerHTML=rptHead('LAPORAN BULANAN PROYEK (MONTHLY PROGRESS REPORT)')+`
  <div class="sect"><h4>Identitas Laporan</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Proyek</dt><dd><b>${esc(pCode(m.projectId))}</b> — ${esc(pName(m.projectId))}</dd>
    <dt>Periode</dt><dd><b>${MONTHS[m.month]} ${m.year}</b></dd>
    <dt>Hari Kerja</dt><dd>${m.days} hari • ${m.reports} laporan harian</dd><dt>Status</dt><dd>${stBadge(m.status)}</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Progress Fisik</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Rencana</dt><dd>${num(m.plan,2)}%</dd><dt>Realisasi</dt><dd><b>${num(m.actual,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Deviasi</dt><dd><b style="color:${dv>=0?'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}">${dv>=0?'+':''}${num(dv,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Kumulatif</dt><dd><b>${num(m.cum,2)}%</b></dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Progress Keuangan</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Rencana Tagihan</dt><dd>${fmtRp(m.finPlan)}</dd><dt>Realisasi Tagihan</dt><dd><b>${fmtRp(m.finAct)}</b></dd>
    <dt>Realisasi Biaya</dt><dd>${fmtRp(m.finCost)}</dd><dt>Progress Keuangan</dt><dd><b>${num(m.finPct,2)}%</b></dd>
    <dt>Margin Kotor</dt><dd><b style="color:${(m.finAct-m.finCost)>=0?'var(--green)':'var(--red)'}">${fmtRp(m.finAct-m.finCost)}</b></dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Sumber Daya</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Total Manhours</dt><dd>${int(m.mh)} jam-orang</dd><dt>Rata-rata Manpower</dt><dd>${m.mp} orang/hari</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Pencapaian Utama</h4><div>${nl(m.done||'-')}</div></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Kendala & Tindakan Korektif</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Kendala</dt><dd>${nl(m.issue||'Tidak ada')}</dd><dt>Tindakan Korektif</dt><dd>${nl(m.corrective||'-')}</dd></dl></div>
  <div class="sect"><h4>Rencana Bulan Depan</h4><div>${nl(m.next||'-')}</div></div>
  ${m.recom?`<div class="sect"><h4>Rekomendasi kepada Manajemen</h4><div>${nl(m.recom)}</div></div>`:''}
  <div class="sect"><h4>Statistik HSE</h4><dl class="detail-grid">
    <dt>Safe Manhours</dt><dd><b>${int(m.safeMh)}</b></dd><dt>Toolbox Meeting</dt><dd>${m.tbm} sesi</dd>
    <dt>Near Miss</dt><dd>${m.nearMiss}</dd><dt>Incident / LTI</dt><dd>${m.incident}</dd>
    <dt>Status K3</dt><dd>${m.incident===0?'<span class="badge b-g">✅ ZERO ACCIDENT</span>':'<span class="badge b-r">⚠️ PERLU EVALUASI</span>'}</dd></dl></div>
  ${sign(m.createdBy,m.approvedBy)}`;
  opn('mView');
}

/* ================= HSE ================= */
function renderHSE(){
  const d=DB.daily;
  const mh=d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manhours||0),0);
  const nm=d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.nearMiss||0),0);
  const inc=d.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.incident||0),0);
  const tb=d.filter(x=>x.tbm).length;
  document.getElementById('h1').textContent=int(inc===0?mh:mh);
  document.getElementById('h2').textContent=nm;document.getElementById('h3').textContent=inc;document.getElementById('h4').textContent=tb;
  document.getElementById('hseT').innerHTML=DB.projects.length?DB.projects.map(p=>{
    const r=d.filter(x=>x.projectId===p.id);
    const m=r.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.manhours||0),0),n=r.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.nearMiss||0),0),
      i=r.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.incident||0),0),t=r.filter(x=>x.tbm).length;
    const lt=m>0?(i*1000000/m).toFixed(2):'0.00';
    return `<tr><td><b>${esc(p.code)}</b><br><small style="color:var(--muted)">${esc(p.name)}</small></td><td>${int(m)}</td><td>${t}</td><td>${n}</td>
      <td><b style="color:${i>0?'var(--red)':'var(--green)'}">${i}</b></td><td>${lt}</td>
      <td>${i===0?'<span class="badge b-g">ZERO ACCIDENT</span>':'<span class="badge b-r">PERLU EVALUASI</span>'}</td></tr>`}).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="7"><div class="empty"><span class="em">⛑️</span>Belum ada data HSE.</div></td></tr>';
  const mp=new Map();d.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).forEach(x=>{const k=x.date.substr(0,7);mp.set(k,(mp.get(k)||0)+(+x.manhours||0))});
  lineChart('chartH',[...mp.keys()].map(k=>MONTHS[+k.substr(5,2)-1].substr(0,3)+' '+k.substr(2,2)),[{data:[...mp.values()],color:'#16A34A',fill:1}],230);
  const iss=d.filter(x=>(x.issue&&x.issue.trim())||x.incident>0).sort((a,b)=>b.date.localeCompare(a.date)).slice(0,25);
  document.getElementById('issueT').innerHTML=iss.length?iss.map(x=>`<tr><td>${fmtD(x.date)}</td><td>${esc(pCode(x.projectId))}</td>
    <td>${nl(x.issue||'-')}${x.incident>0?' <span class="badge b-r">INCIDENT</span>':''}</td><td>${nl(x.solution||'-')}</td>
    <td>${x.solution&&x.solution.trim()?'<span class="badge b-g">Closed</span>':'<span class="badge b-a">Open</span>'}</td></tr>`).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="5"><div class="empty"><span class="em">✅</span>Tidak ada kendala atau insiden tercatat.</div></td></tr>';
}

/* ================= S-CURVE ================= */
function renderSC(){
  fillProjSel();
  const pid=val('scProj');
  const d=(pid?DB.daily.filter(x=>x.projectId===pid):DB.daily).slice().sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
  const p=DB.projects.find(x=>x.id===pid);
  const cum=d.length?Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.progCum||0)):0;
  const pl=d.length?Math.max(...d.map(x=>+x.planCum||0)):(p?p.plan:0);
  const dev=cum-pl;
  document.getElementById('scInfo').innerHTML=`
    <div class="kpi b" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Progress Rencana</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${num(pl,2)}%</div></div>
    <div class="kpi o" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Progress Aktual</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${num(cum,2)}%</div></div>
    <div class="kpi ${dev>=0?'g':'r'}" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Deviasi</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${dev>=0?'+':''}${num(dev,2)}%</div><div class="dl">${dev>=0?'On/Ahead Schedule':'Behind Schedule'}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi a" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Jumlah Laporan</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${d.length}</div><div class="dl">Daily Report</div></div>`;
  lineChart('chartSC',d.map(x=>fmtD(x.date).substr(0,5)),
    [{data:d.map(x=>+x.planCum||0),color:'#1B4E8C',fill:1},
     {data:d.map(x=>+x.progCum||0),color:'#F28C28',fill:1},
     {data:d.map(x=>+x.progDay||0),color:'#16A34A'}],300);
  document.getElementById('scT').innerHTML=d.length?d.slice().reverse().map((x,i,arr)=>{
    const prev=arr[i+1];const tr=prev?(+x.progDay)-(+prev.progDay):0;
    const act=(x.activities||[]).map(a=>a.d).filter(Boolean).join('; ')||'-';
    const vol=(x.activities||[]).map(a=>a.v?`${a.v} ${a.u}`:'').filter(Boolean).join(', ')||'-';
    return `<tr><td>${fmtD(x.date)}</td><td style="font-size:12px">${esc(act.length>80?act.substr(0,80)+'…':act)}</td><td style="font-size:12px">${esc(vol)}</td>
      <td><b style="color:var(--green)">+${num(x.progDay,2)}%</b></td><td>${num(x.progCum,2)}%</td>
      <td>${tr>0?'<span class="badge b-g">▲ Naik</span>':tr<0?'<span class="badge b-r">▼ Turun</span>':'<span class="badge b-n">— Tetap</span>'}</td></tr>`}).join('')
    :'<tr><td colspan="6"><div class="empty"><span class="em">📈</span>Belum ada data progress.</div></td></tr>';
}

/* ================= BUDGET FORECASTING ================= */
function fillOpsProject(id){const el=document.getElementById(id);if(!el)return;const old=el.value;el.innerHTML='<option value="">— Pilih Proyek —</option>'+DB.projects.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${esc(p.code)} — ${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join('');if(old)el.value=old}
function renderCorrelation(){
  const sel=document.getElementById('corrProject');if(!sel)return;
  const old=sel.value;sel.innerHTML='<option value="">Semua Proyek</option>'+DB.projects.map(p=>`<option value="${p.id}">${esc(p.code)} — ${esc(p.name)}</option>`).join('');if(old)sel.value=old;
  const pid=sel.value,period=val('corrPeriod');
  const match=x=>!pid||x.projectId===pid;
  const daily=DB.daily.filter(match).filter(x=>!period||String(x.date||'').slice(0,7)===period).sort((a,b)=>String(a.date).localeCompare(String(b.date)));
  const weekly=DB.weekly.filter(match).filter(x=>!period||String(x.dateTo||x.dateFrom||'').slice(0,7)===period).sort((a,b)=>String(a.dateTo||'').localeCompare(String(b.dateTo||'')));
  const monthly=DB.monthly.filter(match).filter(x=>!period||`${x.year}-${String((+x.month||0)+1).padStart(2,'0')}`===period).sort((a,b)=>(a.year-b.year)||(a.month-b.month));
  const budgets=DB.budgets.filter(match).filter(x=>!period||x.period===period);
  const materials=DB.materials.filter(match);
  const stock=x=>(+x.opening||0)+(+x.inQty||0)-(+x.outQty||0);
  const latestD=daily[daily.length-1],latestW=weekly[weekly.length-1],latestM=monthly[monthly.length-1];
  const progress=latestD?+latestD.progCum||0:latestW?+latestW.cum||0:latestM?+latestM.cum||0:0;
  const progressSource=latestD?'Daily':latestW?'Weekly':latestM?'Monthly':'Belum ada';
  const plan=budgets.reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.plan||0),0),actual=budgets.reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.actual||0),0),forecast=budgets.reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.actual||0)+(+x.remain||0),0);
  const low=materials.filter(x=>stock(x)<=(+x.min||0));
  const usedDaily={};daily.forEach(d=>(d.materials||[]).forEach(m=>{const key=String(m.n||'').trim().toLowerCase();if(key)usedDaily[key]=(usedDaily[key]||0)+(+m.q||0)}));
  const warehouseUsage=materials.reduce((a,m)=>a+(+m.outQty||0),0),reportedUsage=Object.values(usedDaily).reduce((a,n)=>a+n,0);
  const dev=forecast-plan,spentPct=plan?actual/plan*100:0;
  const k=document.getElementById('corrKpi');if(!k)return;
  k.innerHTML=`<div class="kpi b"><div class="lb">Progress Kumulatif (${esc(progressSource)})</div><div class="vl">${num(progress,2)}%</div></div><div class="kpi ${spentPct>progress&&plan?'r':'g'}"><div class="lb">Realisasi Budget / Anggaran</div><div class="vl">${num(spentPct,1)}%</div><div class="dl">${fmtRp(actual)} / ${fmtRp(plan)}</div></div><div class="kpi ${dev>0?'r':'g'}"><div class="lb">Deviasi Forecast</div><div class="vl">${fmtRp(dev)}</div></div><div class="kpi ${low.length?'r':'g'}"><div class="lb">Material di Bawah Minimum</div><div class="vl">${low.length}</div></div>`;
  const statusBudget=!budgets.length?'Belum ada budget untuk filter ini':spentPct>progress+5?'Risiko biaya: realisasi lebih cepat daripada progress':dev>0?'Forecast melebihi anggaran':'Biaya relatif sejalan / di bawah anggaran';
  const usageMatch=materials.filter(m=>usedDaily[String(m.name||'').trim().toLowerCase()]!==undefined);
  const rows=[
    ['Daily Report','Jumlah laporan & progress terakhir',`${daily.length} laporan · ${num(progress,2)}% (${progressSource})`,'Gunakan progress kumulatif sebagai pembanding konsumsi biaya dan target proyek.'],
    ['Weekly Report','Realisasi vs rencana mingguan',latestW?`${num(latestW.actual,2)}% aktual / ${num(latestW.plan,2)}% rencana`:'Belum ada weekly report',latestW?(latestW.actual<latestW.plan?'Progress tertinggal dari rencana mingguan. Evaluasi tenaga, alat, material, dan kendala.':'Progress mingguan memenuhi atau melampaui rencana.'):'Buat Weekly Report dan tarik data dari Daily Report.'],
    ['Monthly Report','Progress & biaya bulanan',latestM?`${MONTHS[latestM.month]} ${latestM.year} · ${num(latestM.actual,2)}% aktual · biaya ${fmtRp(latestM.finAct)}`:'Belum ada monthly report',latestM?'Bandingkan realisasi biaya bulanan dengan Budget Forecasting periode yang sama.':'Buat Monthly Report agar evaluasi bulanan bisa dikorelasikan.'],
    ['Budget Forecasting','Anggaran, realisasi, forecast',budgets.length?`${fmtRp(plan)} anggaran · ${fmtRp(actual)} realisasi · ${fmtRp(forecast)} forecast`: 'Belum ada data budget',statusBudget],
    ['Material Control Warehouse','Stok akhir dan material kritis',`${materials.length} item · ${low.length} item stok menipis`,low.length?`Prioritaskan pengadaan: ${low.slice(0,5).map(x=>x.name).join(', ')}${low.length>5?' dan lainnya':''}`:'Stok seluruh item di atas batas minimum. Tetap cocokkan kebutuhan dengan rencana kerja.'],
    ['Pemakaian Material Daily vs Warehouse','Pencocokan pemakaian',`${num(reportedUsage,2)} qty pada Daily · ${num(warehouseUsage,2)} qty keluar di warehouse`,usageMatch.length?`${usageMatch.length} nama material cocok. Periksa selisih karena satuan, rentang tanggal, dan pencatatan stok dapat berbeda.`:'Belum ada nama material yang cocok otomatis. Samakan nama material dan satuan di Daily Report dan Warehouse.']
  ];
  document.getElementById('corrRows').innerHTML=rows.map(r=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(r[0])}</b></td><td>${esc(r[1])}</td><td>${esc(r[2])}</td><td>${esc(r[3])}</td></tr>`).join('');
}
function renderBudget(){
  fillOpsProject('bProject');renderCorrelation();const totalPlan=DB.budgets.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.plan||0),0),totalActual=DB.budgets.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.actual||0),0),totalForecast=DB.budgets.reduce((a,b)=>a+(+b.actual||0)+(+b.remain||0),0);
  document.getElementById('budgetKpi').innerHTML=`<div class="kpi b"><div class="lb">Total Anggaran</div><div class="vl">${fmtRp(totalPlan)}</div></div><div class="kpi o"><div class="lb">Realisasi</div><div class="vl">${fmtRp(totalActual)}</div><div class="dl">${totalPlan?num(totalActual/totalPlan*100,1):'0'}% dari anggaran</div></div><div class="kpi a"><div class="lb">Forecast Akhir</div><div class="vl">${fmtRp(totalForecast)}</div></div><div class="kpi ${totalForecast>totalPlan?'r':'g'}"><div class="lb">Deviasi Forecast</div><div class="vl">${fmtRp(totalForecast-totalPlan)}</div></div>`;
  const rows=DB.budgets.slice().sort((a,b)=>(b.period||'').localeCompare(a.period||''));document.getElementById('budgetRows').innerHTML=rows.length?rows.map(b=>{const fc=(+b.actual||0)+(+b.remain||0),dev=fc-(+b.plan||0);return `<tr><td>${esc(pCode(b.projectId))} · ${esc(pName(b.projectId))}</td><td>${esc(b.period||'-')}</td><td>${esc(b.category)}</td><td>${fmtRp(b.plan)}</td><td>${fmtRp(b.actual)}</td><td><b>${fmtRp(fc)}</b></td><td style="color:${dev>0?'var(--red)':'var(--green)'}">${fmtRp(dev)}</td><td>${esc(b.note||'-')}</td><td><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="deleteBudget('${b.id}')">Hapus</button></td></tr>`}).join(''):'<tr><td colspan="9"><div class="empty">Belum ada data budget. Isi form di atas untuk mulai forecasting.</div></td></tr>';
}
function saveBudget(){const projectId=val('bProject'),period=val('bPeriod'),plan=Number(val('bPlan')),actual=Number(val('bActual')),remain=Number(val('bRemain'));if(!projectId||!period||val('bPlan')===''||plan<0||actual<0||remain<0){toast('Pilih proyek dan periode, isi anggaran dengan angka valid.','er');return}DB.budgets.push({id:uid(),projectId,period,category:val('bCategory'),plan,actual,remain,note:val('bNote').trim(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});if(save()){renderBudget();['bPlan','bActual','bRemain','bNote'].forEach(id=>setV(id,''));toast('Budget forecasting tersimpan.')}}
function deleteBudget(id){if(!confirm('Hapus data budget ini?'))return;DB.budgets=DB.budgets.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();renderBudget()}
/* ================= MATERIAL CONTROL ================= */
function renderMaterial(){fillOpsProject('mProject');const arr=DB.materials;const stock=x=>(+x.opening||0)+(+x.inQty||0)-(+x.outQty||0);const low=arr.filter(x=>stock(x)<=(+x.min||0)).length;
 document.getElementById('materialKpi').innerHTML=`<div class="kpi b"><div class="lb">Jenis Material</div><div class="vl">${arr.length}</div></div><div class="kpi g"><div class="lb">Total Barang Masuk</div><div class="vl">${int(arr.reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.inQty||0),0))}</div></div><div class="kpi o"><div class="lb">Total Pemakaian</div><div class="vl">${int(arr.reduce((a,x)=>a+(+x.outQty||0),0))}</div></div><div class="kpi ${low?'r':'g'}"><div class="lb">Stok Menipis</div><div class="vl">${low}</div></div>`;
 document.getElementById('materialRows').innerHTML=arr.length?arr.map(x=>{const st=stock(x),isLow=st<=(+x.min||0);return `<tr><td>${esc(pCode(x.projectId))}</td><td>${esc(x.code||'-')}</td><td><b>${esc(x.name)}</b><br><small>${esc(x.unit||'')}</small></td><td>${esc(x.category||'-')}</td><td>${int(x.inQty)}</td><td>${int(x.outQty)}</td><td><b>${int(st)} ${esc(x.unit||'')}</b></td><td>${int(x.min)}</td><td><span class="badge ${isLow?'b-r':'b-g'}">${isLow?'Stok Menipis':'Aman'}</span></td><td>${esc(x.location||'-')}<br><small>${esc(x.supplier||'-')}</small></td><td><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="deleteMaterial('${x.id}')">Hapus</button></td></tr>`}).join(''):'<tr><td colspan="11"><div class="empty">Belum ada data material. Tambahkan stok material proyek di atas.</div></td></tr>';
}
function saveMaterial(){const projectId=val('mProject'),name=val('mName').trim(),unit=val('mUnit').trim();const opening=Number(val('mOpening')),inQty=Number(val('mIn')),outQty=Number(val('mOut')),min=Number(val('mMin'));if(!projectId||!name||!unit||[opening,inQty,outQty,min].some(n=>!Number.isFinite(n)||n<0)||opening+inQty<outQty){toast('Lengkapi proyek, nama, satuan dan pastikan stok tidak negatif.','er');return}DB.materials.push({id:uid(),projectId,code:val('mCode').trim(),name,category:val('mCategory'),unit,opening,inQty,outQty,min,location:val('mLocation').trim(),supplier:val('mSupplier').trim(),updatedAt:new Date().toISOString()});if(save()){renderMaterial();['mCode','mName','mUnit','mLocation','mSupplier'].forEach(id=>setV(id,''));['mOpening','mIn','mOut','mMin'].forEach(id=>setV(id,'0'));toast('Data material berhasil disimpan.')}}
function deleteMaterial(id){if(!confirm('Hapus data material ini?'))return;DB.materials=DB.materials.filter(x=>x.id!==id);save();renderMaterial()}

/* ================= EXPORT ================= */
function renderExp(){
  fillProjSel();
  const sz=(new Blob([JSON.stringify(DB)]).size/1024).toFixed(1);
  document.getElementById('dbStat').innerHTML=`
    <div class="kpi b" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Proyek</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${DB.projects.length}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi o" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Daily Report</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${DB.daily.length}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi g" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Weekly / Monthly</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${DB.weekly.length} / ${DB.monthly.length}</div></div>
    <div class="kpi a" style="padding:13px"><div class="lb">Ukuran Data</div><div class="vl" style="font-size:22px">${sz} KB</div></div>`;
}
function dl(name,content,type){
  const b=new Blob([content],{type});const u=URL.createObjectURL(b);const a=document.createElement('a');
  a.href=u;a.download=name;a.click();URL.revokeObjectURL(u);
}
function csvRow(a){return a.map(v=>`"${String(v??'').replace(/"/g,'""').replace(/\n/g,' ')}"`).join(';')}
function expCSV(t){
  let rows=[],fn='';
  if(t==='budget'){fn='Budget_Forecasting';rows.push(['Proyek','Periode','Kategori','Anggaran','Realisasi','Estimasi Sisa','Forecast Akhir','Deviasi','Catatan']);DB.budgets.forEach(b=>rows.push([pCode(b.projectId),b.period,b.category,b.plan,b.actual,b.remain,(+b.actual||0)+(+b.remain||0),((+b.actual||0)+(+b.remain||0))-(+b.plan||0),b.note]))}
  if(t==='materials'){fn='Material_Control';rows.push(['Proyek','Kode','Material','Kategori','Satuan','Stok Awal','Masuk','Keluar','Stok Akhir','Minimum','Lokasi','Supplier']);DB.materials.forEach(m=>rows.push([pCode(m.projectId),m.code,m.name,m.category,m.unit,m.opening,m.inQty,m.outQty,(+m.opening||0)+(+m.inQty||0)-(+m.outQty||0),m.min,m.location,m.supplier]))}
  if(t==='projects'){fn='Master_Proyek';rows.push(['Kode','Nama','Klien','Lingkup','Lokasi','Mulai','Selesai','Nilai','Target Vol','Satuan','PM','Plan %','Actual %','Status','Username Proyek','Hak Akses']);
    DB.projects.forEach(p=>rows.push([p.code,p.name,p.client,p.scope,p.location,p.start,p.end,p.value,p.targetVol,p.unit,p.pm,p.plan,prog(p.id).toFixed(2),p.status,p.accessUser||'',p.accessRole||'viewer']))}
  if(t==='daily'){fn='Daily_Report';rows.push(['Tanggal','Proyek','Lokasi','Cuaca','Manpower','Manhours','Aktivitas','Prog Harian %','Kumulatif %','Plan %','TBM','Near Miss','Incident','Kendala','Solusi','Rencana Besok','Dibuat Oleh','Status']);
    DB.daily.slice().sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date)).forEach(d=>rows.push([d.date,pCode(d.projectId),d.location,d.weather,d.manpower,d.manhours,
      (d.activities||[]).map(a=>`${a.d} (${a.v} ${a.u})`).join(' | '),d.progDay,d.progCum,d.planCum,d.tbm?'Ya':'Tidak',d.nearMiss,d.incident,d.issue,d.solution,d.nextPlan,d.createdBy,d.status]))}
  if(t==='weekly'){fn='Weekly_Report';rows.push(['Minggu','Dari','Sampai','Proyek','Plan %','Actual %','Deviasi %','Kumulatif %','Hari','Manpower','Manhours','Pekerjaan','Kendala','Mitigasi','Rencana','Status']);
    DB.weekly.forEach(w=>rows.push([w.weekNo,w.dateFrom,w.dateTo,pCode(w.projectId),w.plan,w.actual,(w.actual-w.plan).toFixed(2),w.cum,w.days,w.mp,w.mh,w.done,w.issue,w.mitigation,w.next,w.status]))}
  if(t==='monthly'){fn='Monthly_Report';rows.push(['Bulan','Tahun','Proyek','Fisik Plan %','Fisik Actual %','Deviasi %','Kumulatif %','Keu Plan','Keu Actual','Biaya','Keu %','Manhours','Pencapaian','Kendala','Korektif','Rencana','Status']);
    DB.monthly.forEach(m=>rows.push([MONTHS[m.month],m.year,pCode(m.projectId),m.plan,m.actual,(m.actual-m.plan).toFixed(2),m.cum,m.finPlan,m.finAct,m.finCost,m.finPct,m.mh,m.done,m.issue,m.corrective,m.next,m.status]))}
  if(rows.length<=1){toast('Tidak ada data untuk diexport.','wr');return}
  dl(`BSP_${fn}_${localISODate()}.csv`,'\uFEFF'+rows.map(csvRow).join('\n'),'text/csv;charset=utf-8');
  toast('File CSV berhasil diunduh!','ok');
}
function printRecap(){
  const pid=val('prProj'),ty=val('prType');const s=DB.settings;
  const P=pid?DB.projects.filter(p=>p.id===pid):DB.projects;
  let h=`<div style="text-align:center;border-bottom:3px double #0B2A4A;padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:18px">
    <div style="font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#0B2A4A">${esc(s.name)}</div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666">${esc(s.address)}</div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666">Telp: ${esc(s.phone)} • ${esc(s.email)}</div>
    <div style="margin-top:12px;font-size:15px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:1px">REKAPITULASI LAPORAN PROYEK</div>
    <div style="font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-top:3px">Dicetak: ${new Date().toLocaleString('id-ID')}</div></div>`;
  P.forEach(p=>{
    h+=`<h3 style="background:#0B2A4A;color:#fff;padding:8px 11px;margin:16px 0 9px;font-size:13px;border-radius:5px">${esc(p.code)} — ${esc(p.name)}</h3>
    <table style="width:100%;font-size:11px;margin-bottom:10px"><tr><td style="width:50%"><b>Klien:</b> ${esc(p.client||'-')}</td><td><b>Lingkup:</b> ${esc(p.scope)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Lokasi:</b> ${esc(p.location||'-')}</td><td><b>Periode:</b> ${fmtD(p.start)} s/d ${fmtD(p.end)}</td></tr>
    <tr><td><b>Nilai Kontrak:</b> ${fmtRp(p.value)}</td><td><b>Progress:</b> ${num(prog(p.id),2)}% / plan ${num(p.plan,0)}%</td></tr></table>`;
    if(ty==='daily'||ty==='all'){const d=DB.daily.filter(x=>x.projectId===p.id).sort((a,b)=>a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
      if(d.length){h+=`<h4 style="font-size:11.5px;color:#0B2A4A;margin:10px 0 5px">A. DAILY REPORT (${d.length} laporan)</h4>
      <table border="1" style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px"><tr style="background:#eef2f7"><th>Tgl</th><th>Lokasi</th><th>Cuaca</th><th>MP</th><th>MH</th><th>Aktivitas</th><th>Hari%</th><th>Kum%</th></tr>
      ${d.map(x=>`<tr><td>${fmtD(x.date)}</td><td>${esc(x.location||'-')}</td><td>${esc((x.weather||'').replace(/[^\w\s]/g,''))}</td><td align="center">${x.manpower}</td><td align="center">${x.manhours}</td>
      <td>${esc((x.activities||[]).map(a=>a.d).join('; ').substr(0,90))}</td><td align="center">${num(x.progDay,2)}</td><td align="center">${num(x.progCum,2)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>`}}
    if(ty==='weekly'||ty==='all'){const w=DB.weekly.filter(x=>x.projectId===p.id);
      if(w.length){h+=`<h4 style="font-size:11.5px;color:#0B2A4A;margin:10px 0 5px">B. WEEKLY REPORT (${w.length} laporan)</h4>
      <table border="1" style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px"><tr style="background:#eef2f7"><th>Mg</th><th>Periode</th><th>Plan%</th><th>Act%</th><th>Dev%</th><th>Kum%</th><th>MH</th><th>Pekerjaan</th></tr>
      ${w.map(x=>`<tr><td align="center">${x.weekNo}</td><td>${fmtD(x.dateFrom)}–${fmtD(x.dateTo)}</td><td align="center">${num(x.plan,2)}</td><td align="center">${num(x.actual,2)}</td>
      <td align="center">${num(x.actual-x.plan,2)}</td><td align="center">${num(x.cum,2)}</td><td align="center">${x.mh}</td><td>${esc((x.done||'').substr(0,110))}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>`}}
    if(ty==='monthly'||ty==='all'){const m=DB.monthly.filter(x=>x.projectId===p.id);
      if(m.length){h+=`<h4 style="font-size:11.5px;color:#0B2A4A;margin:10px 0 5px">C. MONTHLY REPORT (${m.length} laporan)</h4>
      <table border="1" style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:10px"><tr style="background:#eef2f7"><th>Periode</th><th>Plan%</th><th>Act%</th><th>Dev%</th><th>Kum%</th><th>Keu. Rencana</th><th>Keu. Realisasi</th></tr>
      ${m.map(x=>`<tr><td>${MONTHS[x.month]} ${x.year}</td><td align="center">${num(x.plan,2)}</td><td align="center">${num(x.actual,2)}</td><td align="center">${num(x.actual-x.plan,2)}</td>
      <td align="center">${num(x.cum,2)}</td><td align="right">${fmtRp(x.finPlan)}</td><td align="right">${fmtRp(x.finAct)}</td></tr>`).join('')}</table>`}}
  });
  h+=`<div style="display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:30px;margin-top:34px;text-align:center;font-size:12px">
    <div><div style="color:#666;margin-bottom:58px">Dibuat Oleh,</div><div style="border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:5px"><b>${esc(USER.name)}</b></div></div>
    <div><div style="color:#666;margin-bottom:58px">Mengetahui,</div><div style="border-top:1px solid #333;padding-top:5px"><b>${esc(s.director)}</b><br><small>Direktur Utama</small></div></div></div>`;
  const w=window.open('','_blank');
  if(!w){toast('Popup diblokir browser. Izinkan popup untuk mencetak laporan.','wr');return}
  w.document.write(`<html><head><title>Rekap Laporan BSP</title><style>body{font-family:Arial;font-size:11px;padding:18px;color:#111}
  th,td{padding:4px 5px}table{page-break-inside:auto}tr{page-break-inside:avoid}h3{page-break-after:avoid}</style></head><body>${h}</body></html>`);
  w.document.close();setTimeout(()=>w.print(),500);
}
function backup(){dl(`BSP_Backup_${localISODate()}.json`,JSON.stringify(DB,null,2),'application/json');toast('Backup berhasil diunduh!','ok')}
function restore(e){
  const f=e.target.files[0];if(!f)return;
  if(!confirm('Restore akan MENIMPA seluruh data saat ini. Lanjutkan?'))return;
  const r=new FileReader();r.onload=ev=>{try{const d=JSON.parse(ev.target.result);
    if(!d||typeof d!=='object'||!Array.isArray(d.projects)||!Array.isArray(d.daily)||!Array.isArray(d.weekly)||!Array.isArray(d.monthly))throw new Error('Struktur backup tidak sesuai');
    DB={...DB,...d,users:Array.isArray(d.users)&&d.users.length?d.users:DB.users,settings:{...DB.settings,...(d.settings||{})}};
    if(save()){initAll();toast('Data berhasil dipulihkan!','ok')}}
    catch{toast('File backup tidak valid!','er')}};r.readAsText(f);e.target.value='';
}
function resetAll(){
  if(USER.role!=='admin'){toast('Hanya Administrator yang dapat menghapus data.','er');return}
  if(!confirm('⚠️ PERINGATAN!\n\nSeluruh data proyek & laporan akan DIHAPUS PERMANEN.\nPastikan Anda sudah melakukan backup.\n\nLanjutkan?'))return;
  if(!confirm('Konfirmasi sekali lagi: Hapus SEMUA data?'))return;
  DB.projects=[];DB.daily=[];DB.weekly=[];DB.monthly=[];save();initAll();toast('Semua data telah dihapus.','wr');
}

/* ================= SETTING ================= */
function renderSet(){
  const s=DB.settings||{};
  setV('stNm',s.name||'');setV('stAd',s.address||'');setV('stTp',s.phone||'');setV('stEm',s.email||'');setV('stDu',s.director||'');setV('stWb',s.web||'');
  const table=document.getElementById('userT');
  if(!table)return;
  const users=Array.isArray(DB.users)?DB.users:[];
  table.innerHTML=users.map(u=>`<tr><td><b>${esc(u.name)}</b></td><td>${esc(u.username||'-')}</td><td>${esc(u.email||'-')}</td>
    <td><span class="badge ${u.role==='admin'?'b-r':u.role==='pm'?'b-b':'b-n'}">${({admin:'Administrator',pm:'Project Manager',spv:'Supervisor',viewer:'Viewer'})[u.role]||esc(u.role)}</span></td>
    <td><button class="btn btn-gh btn-sm" onclick="openUser('${esc(u.id)}')">✏️ Edit</button> ${u.id===USER?.id?'<small style="color:var(--muted)">Akun Anda</small>':`<button class="btn btn-dg btn-sm" onclick="delItem('users','${esc(u.id)}')">🗑️ Hapus</button>`}</td></tr>`).join('')||'<tr><td colspan="5" class="empty">Belum ada pengguna.</td></tr>';
}
function saveSet(){
  DB.settings={...(DB.settings||{}),name:val('stNm').trim(),address:val('stAd').trim(),phone:val('stTp').trim(),email:val('stEm').trim(),director:val('stDu').trim(),web:val('stWb').trim()};
  if(save())toast('Pengaturan berhasil disimpan dan diverifikasi.','ok');
}
function openUser(id){
  if(!USER||USER.role!=='admin'){toast('Hanya Administrator yang dapat mengelola pengguna.','er');return}
  ['uId','uNm2','uUn','uEmail','uPw'].forEach(i=>setV(i,''));setV('uRl','spv');
  document.querySelector('#mUser .mh h3').textContent=id?'Edit Pengguna':'Tambah Pengguna';
  if(id){const u=DB.users.find(x=>String(x.id)===String(id));if(u){setV('uId',u.id);setV('uNm2',u.name);setV('uUn',u.username);setV('uEmail',u.email);setV('uRl',u.role);}}
  opn('mUser');
}
async function saveUser(){
  if(!USER||USER.role!=='admin'){toast('Hanya Administrator yang dapat mengelola pengguna.','er');return}
  const id=val('uId'),name=val('uNm2').trim(),username=val('uUn').trim(),email=val('uEmail').trim().toLowerCase(),password=val('uPw'),role=val('uRl')||'spv';
  if(!name||!username||!email||(!id&&!password)){toast('Nama, username, email, dan password untuk pengguna baru wajib diisi.','er');return}
  if(!/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(email)){toast('Format email tidak valid.','er');return}
  const btn=document.querySelector('#mUser .mf .btn-org');if(btn){btn.disabled=true;btn.textContent='MENYIMPAN...'}
  try{
    const body={action:id?'update':'create',id,full_name:name,username,email,role};if(password)body.password=password;
    const {data,error}=await bspClient.functions.invoke('bsp-admin-users',{body});
    if(error)throw error;if(!data?.ok)throw new Error(data?.error||'Server tidak mengonfirmasi penyimpanan');
    await refreshCloudUsers();cls('mUser');toast('Pengguna berhasil disimpan di Supabase.','ok');
  }catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Gagal menyimpan pengguna: '+(e.message||'periksa Edge Function dan hak akses admin.'),'er')}
  finally{if(btn){btn.disabled=false;btn.textContent='💾 Simpan'}}
}
async function deleteCloudUser(id){
  if(!USER||USER.role!=='admin'){toast('Hanya Administrator yang dapat menghapus pengguna.','er');return}
  if(String(id)===String(USER.id)){toast('Akun yang sedang digunakan tidak dapat dihapus.','er');return}
  if(!confirm('Hapus akun pengguna ini dari Supabase? Tindakan tidak dapat dibatalkan.'))return;
  try{const {data,error}=await bspClient.functions.invoke('bsp-admin-users',{body:{action:'delete',id}});if(error)throw error;if(!data?.ok)throw new Error(data?.error||'Penghapusan tidak dikonfirmasi');await refreshCloudUsers();toast('Pengguna berhasil dihapus dari Supabase.','ok')}
  catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Gagal menghapus pengguna: '+(e.message||'periksa Edge Function.'),'er')}
}

/* Data demo disembunyikan/dinonaktifkan untuk penggunaan resmi. */

/* ================= INIT ================= */
function initAll(){
  fillProjSel();renderDash();renderProj();renderDaily();renderWeekly();renderMonthly();renderBudget();renderMaterial();renderHSE();renderSC();renderExp();renderSet();
  document.getElementById('mMon').innerHTML=MONTHS.map((m,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${m}</option>`).join('');
}
load();
// Cloud authentication replaces the previous demo/localStorage login.
try{sessionStorage.removeItem('bsp_user')}catch(e){}
const BSP_CLIENT_READY=(()=>{try{bspClient=window.supabase.createClient(BSP_SUPABASE_URL,BSP_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY);return true}catch(e){console.error(e);toast('Library Supabase gagal dimuat. Periksa koneksi internet.','er');return false}})();
async function bootstrapSupabase(){
  if(!BSP_CLIENT_READY)return;
  try{const {data:{session},error}=await bspClient.auth.getSession();if(error)throw error;if(session?.user){await enterApp(session.user)}}
  catch(e){console.warn('Sesi Supabase tidak dapat dipulihkan:',e);try{await bspClient.auth.signOut()}catch(_){} }
}
bootstrapSupabase();
document.addEventListener('click',e=>{if(e.target.classList.contains('modal'))e.target.classList.remove('on')});
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='Escape')document.querySelectorAll('.modal.on').forEach(m=>m.classList.remove('on'))});
</script>
</body>
</html>
